多智能体系统

[MA-0] A Separation Principle for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大规模协同多智能体强化学习（Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, MARL）中因智能体数量增加而导致的学习效率急剧下降的问题。具体而言，当多个智能体在存在噪声且解耦的动力学环境下运行，同时共享一个全局种群目标时，传统MARL方法由于需要联合学习所有智能体的状态-动作空间，导致计算复杂度呈指数级增长，难以扩展至大规模场景。其核心挑战在于如何在保持性能的同时实现可扩展的协作决策。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）的分离原则（Separation Principle）：将整体种群成本函数上界表示为一个以单智能体条件成本函数作为运输代价的最优传输问题。这一理论突破使得原本复杂的多智能体协同问题被分解为两个独立任务——在单智能体层面学习目标条件化的策略，以及通过最优传输机制进行智能体间的高效协调。基于此原理，作者提出了SALT（Separation-based Assignment and Learning via optimal Transport）算法族，其通过标准强化学习方法训练单智能体策略，并利用最优传输实现动态分配与调度。由于学习过程仅作用于单智能体层级，SALT具备良好的可扩展性，可在训练阶段未覆盖的大规模车队中实现零样本迁移。实验结果表明，在南曼哈顿道路网络的车辆配送任务中，相比最短路径启发式方法，SALT将平均行驶时间降低15%-21%；在随机网格世界中，相较现有MARL基线方法，旅行时间减少23%-61%，并成功扩展至传统方法失效的大规模种群场景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09644
作者: Lucia Pezzetti,Nicolas Lanzetti,Antonio Terpin,Florian Dörfler,Giorgia Ramponi
机构: ETH Zürich(苏黎世联邦理工学院); Caltech(加州理工学院); University of Zürich(苏黎世大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems in which agents evolve under decoupled noisy dynamics but share a population objective. A canonical example is a mobility operator that orchestrates a fleet of vehicles to meet customer demand. The stochastic and time-varying nature of these problems calls for learning approaches, yet existing MARL algorithms do not scale: learning assignment and routing jointly over the full state-action space becomes prohibitive as the number of agents grows. Formulating the problem over the space of probability measures, we prove a separation principle: the population cost-to-go function is upper bounded by an optimal transport problem whose transportation cost is the target-conditioned single-agent cost-to-go function. This simplifies the multi-agent problem to learning a single-agent policy and coordinating the agents via optimal transport. Building on this principle, we introduce SALT (Separation-based Assignment and Learning via optimal Transport), a family of algorithms that learn a target-conditioned single-agent policy using any standard reinforcement learning algorithm, and then coordinate the agents via optimal transport. Since learning occurs at the single-agent level, SALT scales to fleet sizes where MARL baselines become intractable and transfers without retraining to fleet sizes unseen during training. In a vehicle-delivery experiment on the southern Manhattan road network, where MARL baselines are computationally prohibitive, SALT improves travel time by 15-21% over a shortest-path routing heuristic. In stochastic grid worlds, SALT reduces average travel times by 23-61% relative to MARL baselines and scales to population sizes where these methods fail.

[MA-1] Incentive Pathologies in a Live LLM Agent Arena: An Empirical Study of Concentration Reward-Rule Implementation Discrepancy and Network Dilution

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）代理系统中激励机制设计失效与行为异化问题，特别是在复杂自治代理环境中，激励政策调整后实际行为响应与预期目标之间的偏差。其核心挑战在于：现有激励机制在部署后未能有效引导代理产生高质量、可持续的推理行为，反而催生了策略性规避行为，甚至导致系统整体效率下降。解决方案的关键在于通过多维度实证分析揭示激励机制的“表面承诺”与“底层实现”之间的严重脱节——具体表现为：尽管官方宣布的“深度奖励倍数”（continuation bonus）为x10，但代码级重构显示其实际执行机制为一个四条件反滥用门控机制，仅在典型情况下兑现x2.85奖励，并永久阻断自我延续路径；此外，关键行为指标如前4个节点活动得分占比从97.2%骤降至49.4%，事件/节点比显著下降（Mann-Kendall检验，p=8.3e-5），表明系统内部分布趋于分散且活跃度降低。研究进一步指出，激励政策的公告与实际实施之间存在显著时间差（约40小时），凸显了透明度与可审计性的重要性。因此，该研究强调构建可追溯、可验证的公开同行评审机制作为事件记录，以提升激励设计的可信度与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09445
作者: Lei Zhenbing,Lei Chang
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员); University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (中国社会科学院大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph)
备注: 29 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; data available at Zenodo DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23691548

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We audit one live LLM agent arena (AITRAP; 22 autonomous agent seats, ~96,000 reasoning nodes) over nine days (Oct 16-25, 2026), during which the platform deployed two bundled incentive changes: a progressive tax reform (V2.9.3, Oct 19) and a seed-inversion with explorer-side action update (V3.0, Oct 21). These serve as before-and-after markers, not cleanly isolated interventions. Four exploratory predictions are tested against ten data frames (F1-F10) using the Gini coefficient, Top-K concentration share, code-level reconstruction of the continuation-bonus mechanism, and the Mann-Kendall trend test. The Gini analysis is inconclusive at 95% confidence (bootstrap intervals straddle 0.7). The Top-4 node-activity-score share falls from 97.2% (Oct 19, pre-V2.9.3) to 49.4% (Oct 25, post-V3.0; 56.7% under a merge-seat assumption). The continuation bonus, announced as depth-based x10, resolves at code level to a four-condition anti-abuse gate paying x2.85 in the typical case and permanently blocking the self-continuation it superficially rewards; the gate was active ~40 hours before the V3.0 announcement. The events-per-node ratio declines significantly (Mann-Kendall S=-45, z=-3.94, p=8.3e-5) from 7.36 to 7.069. We discuss implications for incentive designers, the announcement-implementation gap, and public peer review as an event record.

[MA-2] Enabling Privacy-Preserving Natural Language Access to Industrial Smart Meter Data

【速读】：该论文旨在解决能源管理与电网运营中非技术型人员难以高效利用大规模、异构的智能电表数据进行异常检测、性能监控及战略决策的问题。核心挑战在于：一方面，从海量遥测数据库中提取可操作洞察需具备高级SQL与数据工程能力，形成显著的技术壁垒；另一方面，关键能源基础设施的数据隐私与安全要求严格，限制了敏感用户数据通过云端大语言模型（LLM）进行处理。为此，论文提出OpenMeter——一种无模式依赖的多智能体系统（Multi-Agent System, MAS），其关键解决方案是将自然语言查询自动转化为可执行代码与可读性分析结果，从而实现非专业人员通过自然语言对话与复杂数据库交互。实验表明，在资源受限的本地硬件上，完整的多智能体协同调度在执行准确率上相较最优单智能体配置提升6.1个百分点（EX-R）；而在前沿规模场景下，各组件仍具价值但应按需启用，说明全量协同的开销仅在强调本地化隐私保护的场景中具有合理性。该架构有效降低了技术门槛，同时兼顾数据安全，推动了遥测数据在电网日常运维与战略决策中的深度应用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09372
作者: Carlos Martín-Abellán,Mark Kröll
机构: Valencian Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence (VRAIN); Universitat Politècnica de València; Know Center Research GmbH
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Databases (cs.DB); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Energy management officers and grid operators increasingly rely on smart meter data for anomaly detection, performance monitoring, and strategic decision-making. However, extracting actionable insights from large-scale, heterogeneous telemetry databases requires advanced SQL and data engineering expertise, creating a critical bottleneck for non-technical personnel. Furthermore, the strict data privacy regulations and security constraints inherent to critical energy infrastructure often prohibit the routing of sensitive consumer data through cloud-based Large Language Models (LLMs). To address these challenges, we present OpenMeter, a schema-agnostic Multi-Agent System (MAS) designed to translate natural language queries into executable code and human-readable insights. This architecture lowers the technical barrier for day-to-day utility operations by empowering non-expert personnel to interact with complex databases through intuitive natural language dialogue, transforming raw telemetry into a highly valuable tool for routine grid workflows and strategic decisions. Multi-scenario ablation studies over this environment demonstrate that full multi-agent orchestration shows its largest observed accuracy gains on resource-constrained local hardware (+6.1 pp EX-R over the strongest single-agent configuration); at frontier scale, individual components retain value but should be enabled selectively, indicating that the cost of full orchestration is justified specifically where privacy demands local execution.

[MA-3] ReSUM: Reasoning -Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Query-Focused Summarization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决长时会议场景下查询聚焦摘要（Query-Focused Summarization, QFS）任务中存在的关键挑战，包括复杂的说话人动态、关键信息稀疏以及数据稀缺等问题。由于会议文本通常包含大量不连贯表达、冗长转录内容及复杂的语篇结构，现有端到端方法在处理此类任务时易出现信息遗漏与幻觉现象，即便采用GPT-4-mini、Gemini等先进大模型亦难以保证摘要的准确性和完整性。其核心问题在于：单一模型在一次处理中难以有效完成信息检索、证据提取与摘要生成之间的复杂推理协同。为此，本文提出ReSUM——一种由规划器协调的模块化多大模型框架，通过引入教师模型的推理知识，将检索器和摘要生成器分别设计为依赖查询与计划条件的可定制组件，从而增强对长上下文的鲁棒性，减少无关探索，并生成更忠实、全面的查询聚焦摘要。该方案的关键创新在于利用分阶段、模块化架构实现任务解耦，结合知识蒸馏机制提升各子模块的针对性与协同效率，显著提升了复杂会议场景下的摘要质量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09349
作者: Sonali,Deeksha Varshney,Asif Ekbal
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 10 pages, 4 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLMs excel at language tasks, but long-meeting QFS remains difficult due to complex speaker dynamics, sparse key information, and limited data. Meetings involve disfluencies, long transcripts and complex discourse. QFS have high risk of information omission, hallucination, even for advanced models such as GPT-4-mini and Gemini. Existing end-to-end methods compress retrieval, evidence extraction, and summary generation into a single pass, failing to handle the complex reasoning required for targeted meeting summaries. We propose ReSUM, a modular multi-LLM framework coordinated by a planner that orchestrates retrieval and summarization agents. By distilling teacher reasoning into query- and plan-conditioned retrievers and summarizers, ReSUM enhances long-context robustness, minimizes irrelevant exploration, and generates more faithful and comprehensive query-focused summaries. Experiments show consistent gains on query-focused meeting summarization benchmarks.

[MA-4] Recursively Self-Improving Electromagnetic Spectrum Agents : Architecture and Operation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决电磁频谱代理（Electromagnetic Spectrum Agents, ESAs）在持续自主运行过程中，因环境与任务需求动态变化而导致现有能力无法适应新条件的问题。其核心挑战在于如何使代理具备持续自我演进的能力，以应对复杂多变的频谱操作场景。解决方案的关键在于提出递归自改进电磁频谱代理（Recursively Self-Improving Electromagnetic Spectrum Agents, RSI-ESAs），通过引入基于运行反馈的闭环学习机制，实现对自身能力的动态更新与累积优化。该方案的核心机制包括问题诊断、候选策略生成、验证评估及知识继承四个环节，利用有效任务版本的保留、修改记录和诊断知识作为指导，使代理能够在多轮迭代中积累任务执行能力与改进经验，从而实现性能的持续提升。案例研究显示，在共享频谱调度任务中，RSI-ESAs在多轮改进后显著提升了任务表现并实现了能力积累，验证了其有效性。论文还指出未来在更广泛任务场景与长期运行中的若干开放性挑战，并为后续能力演化研究提供了方向。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09318
作者: Baolin Chong,Dongfang Xu,Qiaosi Wang,Fuhui Zhou,Qihui Wu
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Electromagnetic spectrum agents (ESAs) must contend with changing environments and task requirements during sustained autonomous operation, yet their existing capabilities may not remain suitable for new operating conditions. This article proposes recursively self-improving electromagnetic spectrum agents (RSI-ESAs) that use operational feedback to update their capabilities and build on prior improvements. We present their architecture and editable components, and describe a self-improvement process encompassing problem diagnosis, candidate generation, validation, and inheritance. By retaining effective task versions and using modification records and diagnostic knowledge to guide subsequent updates, RSI-ESAs can accumulate task capabilities and improvement experience across successive rounds. A shared-spectrum scheduling case study illustrates improved task performance and capability accumulation over multiple improvement rounds under the tested conditions. Finally, we discuss open challenges for broader tasks and long-term operation, outlining research directions for the continued capability development of ESAs.

[MA-5] From Emergence to Reversibility: Toward Reversible Multi-Agent Systems

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在持续学习与演化过程中，传统基于规则的管控机制逐渐失效的问题。随着智能体间知识共享、任务委派与故障自修复能力的增强，系统虽仍能实现原有功能，但已绕过既定的限制路径，导致监管失效——即表面合规的系统实际上已具备规避控制的能力。其核心解决方案是提出“可逆多智能体系统”（Reversible Multi-agent Systems）这一研究范式：确保在系统不断演化的过程中，授权监管者仍能有效限制特定禁止性行为，即使智能体通过学习保留了相关知识或重构了协作路径，也能维持控制效力。关键在于将控制焦点从依赖特定机制转向对“特定效应是否可被产生”的可逆性约束，即无论系统如何演化，目标禁止效应必须保持稀有；同时保障必要服务的持续运行。为此，论文识别出三个核心研究问题：追踪各能力依赖关系、在旧机制失效前完成控制权移交、区分合法修复与非法重构。研究进一步提出通过跨演化路径的控制评估、证据支持的控制声明验证以及权限分配机制来实现对系统干预能力的动态维护。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09054
作者: Zhengye Han,Linda Ng Boyle
机构: New York University (纽约大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent systems become capable through institutional mechanisms, such as rules that route information to agents that act on it. These mechanisms are also natural places to restrict the system. Yet as agents learn, share memory, delegate, and repair failures, the collective can find other paths to the same effects: a restriction on the original mechanism still operates but no longer stops them, while routine performance and compliance checks pass. We propose \textbfReversible Multi-agent Systems as a research agenda: collectives that grow while an authorized supervisor can still restrict specified effects, keep them restricted as agents adapt, and reconstitute useful cooperation under renewed authority. What is reversed is the ability to produce a specified effect; restrictions must hold even if learned knowledge persists. The goal is to preserve effective intervention, not a particular mechanism: at every step of growth, some authorized intervention must keep a specified prohibited effect rare while maintaining required service. We identify three research problems: tracking what capabilities depend on, handing off control before an old mechanism loses its effect, and separating legitimate repair from unauthorized reconstruction. We outline how to evaluate control across growth paths, back control claims with evidence, and allocate the rights to restrict and restore.

[MA-6] Sharing the Road: LLM -Based Bargaining in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic

【速读】：该论文旨在解决混合自治交通中异质驾驶主体（自动驾驶汽车，AV；人类驾驶汽车，HV）在共享道路空间时，如何基于更丰富的个体特征与基于语言的推理机制演化出协商行为，并最终形成集体出行结果的问题。传统研究多依赖于显式设定的行为假设或奖励函数，难以刻画复杂情境下的动态互动。本文提出一种基于大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）的协商框架，使不同目标导向、拥有私有信息的AV与HV代理在多样化交通场景下进行道路空间分配的协商。其解决方案的关键在于利用LLM强大的语义理解与对话生成能力，实现具有上下文感知和意图表达的自然语言协商过程，从而模拟真实世界中复杂的交互逻辑。通过控制实验分析交通构成、代理目标及领域知识的影响，研究发现：协商结果对相对交通密度敏感但不严格遵循比例分配；密度均衡状态下的协调难度更高；公平性目标虽显著提升协议达成率，但未必带来最优资源利用率；且领域知识对协商效果的影响因目标配置而异，凸显了公平性作用的角色依赖性。这些发现表明，基于LLM的协商机制为建模和设计混合自治交通中驾驶主体间的交互提供了新的范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09004
作者: Lingxiao Zhou,Di Chen,Jia Li
机构: Washington State University (华盛顿州立大学); University of California, Davis (加利福尼亚大学戴维斯分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mixed-autonomy traffic involves heterogeneous driving populations competing for shared road space. Previous studies have shown the existence and emergence of collective rationality using game-theoretic and reinforcement learning approaches, which rely on explicitly specified behavioral assumptions or reward functions for driving agents. However, how bargaining behaviors between driving agents evolve and lead to collective outcomes based on richer agent characteristics and language-based reasoning remains less understood. To fill this gap, we develop a bargaining framework based on large language models (LLMs) in which population-level autonomous vehicle (AV) and human-driven vehicle (HV) agents negotiate road-space allocations under heterogeneous objectives and private information. Through controlled experiments varying traffic composition, agent objectives, and traffic-domain knowledge, we examine bargaining behavior, coordination, and resource utilization. Results show that negotiated allocations respond to relative traffic density without strictly following proportional sharing, while density-balanced states exhibit greater coordination difficulty. Fairness-oriented objectives substantially improve agreement rates but do not necessarily yield equally high road-space utilization. Furthermore, domain knowledge affects bargaining outcomes differently across objective configurations, shaping both coordination and the role-dependent effects of fairness. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-based bargaining for modeling and designing interactions among driving agents in mixed-autonomy traffic.

[MA-7] Phantom Consensus: Measuring Social Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体大语言模型（multi-agent LLM systems）在集体决策过程中因对其他智能体行为的错误推理而导致的“虚假共识”（phantom consensus）问题。其核心挑战在于：当智能体接收到模糊的社会信号后，虽仍维持独立的私有判断，却会改变公开决策，并错误估计其他智能体的私有判断，即使群体私有判断并未支持表面达成的一致。这种现象表现为一种类多元无知（pluralistic ignorance）的集体认知偏差。解决方案的关键在于提出并验证一个名为PHANTOM-Bench的基准测试框架，该框架通过分离私有判断、公共决策、对群体私有判断的主观估计、透明度驱动的修复机制以及对照条件（如中性文本和明确投票跟随），系统性地量化此类失败。实验表明，模糊的公共信号可使决策准确率下降高达47.8个百分点，集体理性失效率达47.3%；而揭示各智能体的记录私有判断可在不暴露真实答案的情况下显著修复多数错误。研究强调，评估多智能体系统不应仅关注最终共识，更需检验该共识是否基于独立测量的私有判断，而非由社会信号诱发的虚假一致性。

Abstract:Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly aggregate judgments across model instances, but reasoning about other agents can itself introduce failure. We study a setting in which LLMs shift their public decisions after observing ambiguous social signals while reporting inaccurate estimates of what other agents privately judged, even when the group’s recorded private judgments do not support the apparent consensus. We call this failure phantom consensus and study it as a pluralistic-ignorance-style pattern in controlled LLM collectives. To measure this phenomenon, we introduce PHANTOM-Bench, a benchmark that separates isolated private judgments, public decisions after ambiguous social signals, elicited estimates of the group’s private judgment, transparency-based recovery, and controls for neutral public text and explicit vote-following. Across nine closed- and open-weight models, ambiguous public signals consistently degrade decision quality and can turn correct private group judgments into incorrect public collective outcomes. Public accuracy drops by as much as 47.8 percentage points, and collective rationality failures reach 47.3% in the most susceptible setting. We observe substantial errors in reported group-private beliefs alongside public-stage failures, while control conditions reveal model-dependent differences in susceptibility to ambiguous and explicit peer signals. Revealing the agents’ recorded private decisions repairs many failures without revealing the gold label, although recovery varies across models. Our results show that evaluating multi-agent LLM systems requires measuring not only final agreement, but whether that agreement reflects independently measured private judgments or an apparent consensus.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体辩论（Multi-Agent Debate, MAD）在多模态任务中因固定交互模态导致的精度下降与令牌效率低下的问题。现有方法通常采用固定的文本或图结构进行智能体间证据交换，难以有效传递细粒度的多模态证据，从而引发准确率降低和因冗长描述带来的令牌开销增加。其解决方案的关键在于提出自适应交互框架（Adaptive Interaction in Multi-Agent Debate, AIM），通过动态选择最优的模态组合来实现智能体间的高效交互。AIM不仅支持传统的文本与图模态，还引入了任务相关的模态交互机制，允许智能体在特定任务中交换图像区域、音频片段或时空视频片段等目标区域信息。为确定每实例的最佳模态组合，AIM首先生成结构化基线响应，并提取可解释的路由特征，涵盖任务所需证据类型、基线代理置信度以及各模态对基线的额外信息增益。随后，一个轻量级路由器基于这些特征，规避“融合不足”（遗漏关键证据）与“过度融合”（冗余模态增加令牌开销）的风险，实现精准的模态组合选择。在涵盖三大类多模态任务的八个基准测试中，AIM均达到最高准确率；相比最优单模态基线，多模态融合提升准确率高达6.4%；而针对实例自适应调整模态组合，相较各基准中最优固定组合进一步提升4.2%准确率，同时减少高达53.4%的令牌消耗。

Abstract:Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) improves reasoning on multimodal tasks, but its accuracy and token efficiency depend on how agents interact during debate. A largely overlooked design choice is which interaction modalities agents use to exchange evidence. Existing methods rely on fixed text- or graph-based interaction, which fails to convey fine-grained multimodal evidence and thus degrades accuracy while inflating token cost due to verbose descriptions. To address this, we propose Adaptive Interaction in Multi-Agent Debate (AIM), an adaptive routing framework that dynamically selects the optimal modality combination for inter-agent interaction in multimodal MAD. Beyond text and graph, AIM introduces task-dependent modality interaction, where agents exchange targeted regions of interest from the task-specific multimodal input, such as image regions, audio segments, or spatio-temporal video clips. To determine the best combination for each instance, AIM first generates a structured baseline response and extracts interpretable routing features that capture which evidence the instance requires, how confident the baseline agent is, and how much new evidence each modality would add beyond the baseline response. A lightweight router then uses these routing features to select a modality combination that avoids both under-fusion (i.e., agents miss decisive evidence) and over-fusion (i.e., redundant modalities inflate token cost) risks. Across eight benchmarks spanning three multimodal task families, \name achieves the highest accuracy. Combining modalities improves accuracy by up to 6.4% over the best single-modality baseline, and adapting the combination per instance adds up to 4.2% over the most accurate fixed combination of each benchmark with up to 53.4% fewer tokens.

Abstract:The ODD protocol is the de facto standard for describing agent-based models, but it lacks vocabulary for the components that determine LLM-agent behavior: prompt assembly, memory serialization, parsing, and retry logic. We propose ODD+LLM, a backward-compatible extension adding five documentation blocks grounded in the CoALA cognitive-architecture framework. To show that the gap matters, we conduct a multiverse analysis [Steegen et al., 2016] of a published LLM naming-game simulation, varying six specification choices a reimplementer must make. Variants that are defensible readings of the paper stay within statistical noise of our baseline reconstruction. Missing one instruction that the paper states but is easy to overlook (that the model answers as an outside observer rather than as a player) raises the share of runs settling on the convention agents individually favor from 0.35 to 1.00 and makes convergence three times faster, in a reimplementation that uses a different model from the original. We complement the demonstration with a reconstruction-sufficiency review of 28 published LLM-agent simulations, finding that the details of how prompts are built and how model outputs are parsed are undetermined in 77% of cases, and that no paper fully specifies its main LLM call. ODD+LLM gives the field a standard home for information it already produces but currently scatters across code repositories, supplementary files, and undocumented defaults.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在虚拟人群仿真过程中，如何实现自然语言指令的高效、灵活且可靠控制的问题。传统手工编写规则虽执行高效但缺乏灵活性，而持续调用大语言模型（LLM）进行实时指令解析则带来重复延迟、计算成本高及潜在不支持动作的风险。其解决方案的关键在于提出一个名为CrowdDirector的框架：仅在用户添加或修改指令时调用一次LLM，将自然语言指令转化为结构化指令，并通过场景验证器（scene validator）检查指令中涉及的实体与动作是否存在于当前Unity场景中；经验证通过的指令被持久化存储并在仿真运行期间持续生效。每个仿真周期内，基于图神经网络（Graph Neural Network, GNN）根据当前场景状态和激活指令，为每个代理选择可用的动作与目标，而移动、交互与动画等具体行为仍由Unity引擎处理。该GNN在离线模拟场景中训练，接受来自LLM的指导以学习对指令的响应策略。实验表明，场景验证器的可行性判断比LLM自身评估更接近人类判断，且在行为基准测试中，CrowdDirector比手工规则更准确地遵循用户指令，同时避免了频繁调用LLM，从而在固定规则与持续LLM控制之间提供了一种实用的折中方案。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Natural language offers an intuitive way to direct a virtual crowd while a simulation is running. Handwritten rules execute efficiently but cannot respond flexibly to varied instructions, whereas asking a large language model (LLM) to control the crowd at every update introduces repeated latency, cost, and the risk of unsupported actions. We present CrowdDirector, a framework that uses an LLM only when the user adds or changes an instruction. The LLM translates the request into a structured instruction, and a scene validator checks whether the entities and actions it references exist in the current Unity scene. Accepted instructions are stored and remain continuously active as the simulation is running. At each simulation tick, a graph neural network uses the current scene state and active instruction to choose an available action and target for each agent, while Unity handles movement, interactions, and animation. The network is trained offline on simulated scenarios, with LLM guidance on how agents should respond to instructions. Our evaluations show the scene validator’s feasibility decisions matched human judgements more often than the LLM’s own assessment, and on a behavioural benchmark CrowdDirector follows user instructions more closely than handwritten rules while avoiding repeated LLM calls. It therefore provides a practical middle ground between fixed rules and continuous LLM control.

Abstract:Building agentic pipelines that achieve high task performance while keeping cost and latency low requires jointly optimizing heterogeneous and coupled design choices, including prompts, topology, model selection, and tool policies. Manually searching this combinatorial design space is expensive and time-consuming, while existing automated optimizers typically operate within a predefined subset of this space, modify the pipeline monolithically, or provide little structured evidence for pipeline changes. To mitigate these challenges, we introduce the Decomposed Credit-Assignment Framework (DeCAF), which adapts the design space to the given benchmark and pipeline, optimizes each dimension separately, and generates reasoning traces for every decision. Given a task specification, benchmark examples, and a seed pipeline, DeCAF identifies relevant optimization dimensions and generates diverse experimental hypotheses for each. Independent coding-agent sessions then optimize each dimension under a restricted edit scope, jointly evaluating performance, inference cost, and latency while recording all hypotheses, edits, and outcomes of each experiment. A final synthesis session combines compatible findings across all dimensions and uses a component-level trajectory evaluator, which derives role-specific rubrics from each agent’s instructions, to localize underperforming components and guide cross-dimension revisions. Across a diverse suite of agentic benchmarks, DeCAF improves average task performance by 2.58 percentage points, while reducing inference cost by 4.30% and end-to-end latency by 42.45% compared to the best overall baseline.

Abstract:Groups can achieve more than individuals in the same amount of time, but only if their members coordinate: they must decide who works on what and what to share. However, this organization in multi-agent systems today usually comes from arbitrary, static harnesses designed a priori without adapting to agent behaviors or task specifications. We ask whether agents can instead learn to organize themselves. We introduce s ^3 , the first multi-agent reinforcement learning method in which agents decide for themselves how long to work alone and when to share findings or read teammates’ messages, with no predefined organization or roles. Our s ^3 agents learn to take different approaches, read each other’s work, exhibit emergent roles that complement each other in the swarm, and generalize to bigger teams. We study both coordination, where agents must combine private information, and parallel exploration, where sharing discoveries can make search more efficient. With matched training and inference budgets, s ^3 , swarms evaluated with twice as many agents as in training solve over 25 \times more coordination problems than the strongest baseline, and in exploration, communicating agents reduce repeated work by nearly 50% and outperform best-of-N by up to 9.4 percentage points. Rather than being designed in advance, s ^3 enables organization to emerge from a shared goal. This opens the door to capable systems built from many models that learn to work together.

[MA-13] Aegis OS: A Transactional Multi-Tenant Operating System Runtime for Eliminating Authorization Fatigue in Autonomous Coding Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主编码代理（autonomous coding agents）在实际部署中面临的“安全-自治困境”：一方面，频繁的逐操作确认提示会显著中断工作流（导致45%-57%的工具调用受阻），引发授权疲劳；另一方面，完全放开权限（如使用–yolo或–dangerously-skip-permissions）则使主机文件、SSH/云凭证及API密钥面临提示注入和幻觉攻击的风险。此外，多个代理并发编辑共享工作树时易发生冲突覆盖，而通过大体量代码片段直接嵌入大语言模型（LLM）上下文窗口也带来高昂的令牌开销。为应对上述挑战，论文提出Aegis OS——一个基于Rust实现的事务性多租户代理操作系统运行时，通过模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）与Google Agent2Agent（A2A）协议暴露接口。其核心解决方案在于将授权边界从单个工具调用迁移至事务级工作区边界，并结合内核强制的OS沙箱（macOS Seatbelt与Linux Bubblewrap，含默认拒绝策略、–tmpfs HOME隔离及Unix套接字出站桥接）、基于写时复制（Copy-on-Write, CoW）的影子工作区（APFS clonefile；Linux FICLONE reflink）、身份绑定的HTTP出站代理（支持L7方法/路径作用域的秘密注入与出站数据防泄漏，DLP）、以及内容可寻址存储（Content-Addressable Storage, CAS）的A2A IPC总线，实现了高安全性与高效能的统一。实验表明，在1,500次受控调用与28,087次真实会话中，Aegis OS将提示频率降低94.19%-99.88%（受控）与90.7%-97.9%（真实会话，仅1.12%误报率），在8类共80项攻击中将攻击成功率从100.0%降至0.0%，并在APFS与Btrfs上分别实现78.1 MB的1,000文件仓库克隆耗时6.3毫秒与15.6毫秒，且可准确检测全部10例语法与语义合并冲突。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Autonomous coding agents such as Google Antigravity (agy), Anthropic Claude Code (claude), and OpenAI Codex CLI (codex) execute multi-step software engineering workflows on workstations and cloud hosts. Existing agent environments face a Security-Autonomy Dilemma: operators must choose between per-action confirmation prompts, which interrupt workflows on 45%-57% of tool calls and induce authorization fatigue, or unconfined execution (–yolo / --dangerously-skip-permissions), which exposes host files, SSH/cloud credentials, and API tokens to prompt injection and hallucination risks. Furthermore, concurrent agents editing a shared working tree clobber one another’s changes, while passing large artifacts inline through LLM context windows incurs high token overhead. We present Aegis OS (aegis-os), a transactional, multi-tenant Agent Operating System Runtime in Rust exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Google Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol. Aegis OS shifts the authorization boundary from individual tool calls to transactional workspace boundaries. Each agent runs inside a kernel-enforced OS sandbox (macOS Seatbelt and Linux Bubblewrap with default-deny --tmpfs HOME isolation and a Unix-socket egress bridge) backed by a Copy-on-Write (CoW) shadow workspace (APFS clonefile; single-open Linux FICLONE reflinks), an identity-pinned HTTP Egress Proxy with L7 method/path-scoped secret injection and outbound DLP, and an A2A IPC bus with Content-Addressable Storage (CAS). Across 1,500 controlled calls and 28,087 real calls across 52 coding-agent sessions, Aegis OS reduces prompts by 94.19%-99.88% (controlled) and 90.7%-97.9% (real sessions, 1.12% IPR), lowers attack success rate across 80 attacks in eight categories from 100.0% to 0.0% on macOS and Linux, clones 1,000-file (78.1 MB) repos in 6.3 ms on APFS and 15.6 ms on btrfs, and catches 10/10 syntactic and semantic merge conflicts. [NLP-0] CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大推理模型（Large Reasoning Models, LRMs）在低精度量化（low-precision quantization）过程中性能下降的问题。尽管低精度量化可显著降低推理成本，但激进的量化策略常导致推理任务表现不佳，其根源在于推理初期阶段激活值（activation）波动剧烈，而传统校准方法因忽略早期解码状态，难以捕捉这些动态特征。为此，论文提出一种基于聚类的查找表（Look-Up Table, LUT）量化框架——CodeQuant2，其核心解决方案包括：通过旋转与缩放操作缓解激活异常值影响；利用聚类建模权重分布的非均匀性；根据各层量化难度自适应调整码书（codebook）大小；并基于对推理过程中激活行为的观察，优化校准样本选择以更准确匹配实际解码统计特性。结合定制化的LUT CUDA内核，CodeQuant2在保持高精度的同时，相较BF16实现最高达2.85倍的加速，有效解决了推理任务中低精度量化的性能瓶颈。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09868
作者: Xingyu Liu,Xiangyang Yin,Tianhua Xia,Haiyu Wang,Sai Qian Zhang
机构: Tandon School of Engineering (纽约大学坦顿工程学院); Courant Institute School of Mathematics, Computing, and Data Science (纽约大学柯朗数学科学研究所)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbfCodeQuant2, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to 2.85\times speedup over BF16.

[NLP-1] How far does a hash-only sender go? A pre-registered map of sender memory versus bits for short text messages

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在仅由接收端部署语言模型、发送端仅计算哈希值的轻量级通信架构下，能否以低于传统同领域训练发送端（如PPM order-1）的成本，实现对短人类文本的高效传输。其核心问题是：在资源受限的发送端场景中，如何在保证高送达率的前提下最小化传输开销（包括哈希比特数、失败时的负确认与回退数据）。解决方案的关键在于采用“仅哈希发送”机制，即发送端仅生成并传输消息的哈希值，接收端通过自身语言模型进行解码匹配；若匹配失败，则触发回退机制（2字节负确认+原始文本）。实验结果显示，该方案在1,000条来自Taskmaster-1的数据上成功首传857条，平均成本为192.8比特/消息，虽比PPM order-1多出18.4比特（置信区间10.9–26.3比特），但因超出预注册规则中“不超过1字节”的等效阈值，未被判定为等效。此外，该方案在内存占用介于8,190字节至24,844字节之间时，在比特开销上优于smaz2和Unishox2，而当发送端内存超过PPM order-1时，传统压缩算法更优。尽管扩大接收端搜索范围可恢复一半失败消息并将成本降低至低于PPM order-1，但因每次失败需约三分钟接收端处理时间且仍无法在多数链路上胜过现有方案，故在实际空口时间（airtime）上仍不具优势。本研究以严格可复现的方式报告了所有偏离预注册协议的细节，作为对当前轻量级通信范式边界的实证界定。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09848
作者: Marcelo Samoilenko
机构: Winserv
类目: Information Theory (cs.IT); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code, data and per-message results: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Can a sender that only computes hashes, with a language model only at the receiver, transmit short human text more cheaply than a classical sender trained on the same domain? We answer with one pre-registered run on 1,000 English user utterances from Taskmaster-1. The primary endpoint is the cost per message to deliver 100% of the messages (hash bits, plus a 2-byte negative acknowledgement and the raw text when the first attempt fails), paired against an in-domain PPM order-1 sender. The hash-only sender delivered 857 of 1,000 messages on the first attempt and cost 192.8 bits per message, 18.4 bits more than PPM order 1 (95% bootstrap interval 10.9 to 26.3); by the pre-registered rule it spends more and is not equivalent within one byte. As secondary results we map measured sender memory against bits. The hash-only sender (8,190 B on a host build, keyed BLAKE2b tag included, as in every method) was the cheapest point in bits from 8,190 B up to, but excluding, PPM order 1 at 24,844 B, 45 to 46 bits below smaz2 and Unishox2; from PPM order 1 upwards, in-domain senders spend fewer bits, except order 2 pruned to 16 KiB. In airtime it loses to PPM order 1 on all five links priced, to Unishox2 on four, and to raw text with a tag on two, because each failure costs an acknowledgement frame and a fallback frame. A wider receiver search recovers half of the failures and makes the cost 7.7 bits lower than PPM order 1, at about three minutes of receiver time per failure, and still loses in airtime on four of five links. We report the measurement as a delimitation, with every deviation of the run.

[NLP-2] BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务中键值（Key-Value, KV）缓存占用过高导致的内存容量与带宽瓶颈问题。现有4位微缩量化格式（如NVFP4、MXFP4）虽能减小KV缓存体积并支持在FP4张量核心上运行注意力计算，但算法量化与系统加速之间存在根本性差距：传统量化方法导致严重精度下降，而高精度4位算法依赖向量码本，其查找开销又显著降低解码吞吐量。为此，论文提出BitDecoding-FP4——一种面向原生FP4 KV解码的算法-系统协同设计。其关键创新在于从算法和系统双层面协同优化：在算法层面，通过双残差查询量化（Dual-Residual Query Quantization）将查询拆分为两个FP4张量，使查询logit误差由60%降至1%；采用溢出感知概率缩放（Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling）避免E4M3格式下长上下文概率被舍入为零；引入异常值感知键量化（Outlier-Aware Key Quantization），结合静态平滑、Hadamard旋转与尺度搜索，在逐标记缩放下有效抑制键的异常值影响。在系统层面，通过转置softmax与融合概率量化消除softmax性能瓶颈，并在分页KV缓存上实现堆叠查询矩阵乘法加速（stacked query MMA）。实验表明，BitDecoding-FP4在密集模型与混合专家（MoE）模型（支持分组查询注意力GQA与多头局部注意力MLA）上，相较于BF16 KV缓存仅损失0.5点精度（使用NVFP4时），在MXFP4下损失1点，且在强化学习训练回放中表现与BF16 KV一致。在NVIDIA B300硬件上对Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-30B-A3B进行端到端服务测试，其峰值吞吐量相比BF16 KV提升2.4–3.0倍。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09825
作者: Dayou Du,Woon Yee Ng,Guangming Sheng,Nick Lau,Jianyi Cheng,Luo Mai
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Performance (cs.PF)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The key-value (KV) cache dominates memory capacity and bandwidth in long-context LLM serving. While 4-bit microscaling formats (NVFP4, MXFP4) shrink the cache and run attention on FP4 Tensor Cores, a fundamental gap remains between algorithmic quantization and system-aware acceleration: existing FP4 KV systems use vanilla quantization that causes severe accuracy drops, whereas accuracy-oriented 4-bit algorithms rely on vector codebooks whose lookup overhead degrades decoding throughput. We present BitDecoding-FP4, an algorithm–system co-design for accurate and efficient native FP4 KV decoding. We mitigate three error sources: Dual-Residual Query Quantization splits queries into two FP4 tensors, cutting query logit error from 60% to 1%; Underflow-Aware Probability Scaling prevents E4M3 scales from rounding long-context probabilities to zero; and Outlier-Aware Key Quantization combines static smoothing, Hadamard rotation, and scale search to suppress key outliers under token-wise scaling. At the system level, we remove the softmax bottleneck via transposed softmax with fused probability quantization and stacked query MMA on paged KV caches. Across dense and MoE models with GQA and MLA, BitDecoding-FP4 stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4), and tracks BF16 KV in RL training rollouts. In end-to-end serving on NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, it delivers 2.4-3.0 \times higher peak serving throughput than BF16 KV. The implementation is available at this https URL.

[NLP-3] Compaction decay and reinforcement in a two-tier conversational memory: a paired evaluation against retrieval-augmented generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决对话智能体在记忆管理中的核心挑战：如何高效地决定保留哪些信息以支持后续的问答任务。传统方法采用检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG），即保留完整的对话历史并进行搜索；而替代方案则是将每一轮对话压缩为原子化事实，再基于这些事实进行检索。研究的关键在于通过在LoCoMo数据集上的对比实验，系统评估两种记忆策略的性能差异。其解决方案的核心创新在于提出“压缩式记忆”（compaction）方法，即将对话内容提炼为独立的事实单元，从而显著减少提示词（prompt tokens）消耗（降低34%），并在多数评价类别中取得更高的准确率（71.4% vs. 64.6%，p = 5.5e-08）。然而，研究也揭示了该方法的局限性：当参考答案依赖于原始表述的措辞时，压缩策略反而表现更差，因它舍弃了语言表达形式而仅保留语义内容。这一结构性缺陷表明，压缩方法在回答事实性问题时占优，但在需要复现特定文本表达的任务中则处于劣势。此外，研究还提供了四个负面结果及其统计功效分析，增强了结论的可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09807
作者: Osamudiamen Edogun,Joshua Obigwe,Irfan Mehmood
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 7 figures. Data and code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A conversational agent that remembers has to decide what to keep. Retrieval-augmented generation keeps the transcript and searches it; the alternative is to compact each turn into atomic facts and search those. We compare the two on LoCoMo, with both arms answering all 1,985 questions in one window, against the same stores, with the same generator and judge, and both predictions on one row, which licenses McNemar’s exact test on the 512 questions where they disagree. On the four categories comparable work reports, compaction scores 71.4 per cent against 64.6, a lead of 6.8 points (p = 5.5e-08) at 34 per cent fewer prompt tokens. On all five, including the adversarial set comparable work drops, the lead falls to 2.0 and stops being significant, because the baseline leads adversarial by 14.6. That loss has a structure. Our lead falls as the reference answer demands more source wording, 9.6 points ahead at one or two reference words and 3.1 behind past eight, with token overlap moving the same way, so the judge is not the cause. Compaction keeps what a fact asserts and discards how it was said, so it wins where the answer is a value and loses where it is a phrasing. We also report four negative results with their power calculations. Comments: 7 figures. [NLP-4] Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在多项选择题任务中答案对选项排列顺序敏感的问题，即模型输出的答案会因选项展示顺序不同而发生改变，从而影响结果的可靠性。其核心问题是：当前语言模型在处理多选题时，其决策过程受到输入序列中选项位置的干扰，导致答案不一致，尤其在低置信度情况下更为显著。解决方案的关键在于通过引入选项顺序随机化（option shuffling）的微调策略，使模型学习到对选项顺序无关的判断能力。实验表明，在2,818条经教师验证的数据上进行带顺序打乱的微调后，答案翻转率从11.4%降至7.2%，显著提升了鲁棒性；进一步采用置信度加权投票机制可实现69.7%的准确率，虽计算成本增加4.1倍，但性能优于单一前向传播。此外，使用作者提出的并行布局（parallel layout）进行微调，可将翻转率降至0.5%，展现出极强的稳定性。该研究揭示了现有模型在推理一致性方面的缺陷，并提出有效的训练范式以增强其抗顺序偏倚的能力。

作者: Mohammed Nayeem Khan,Logesh L
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 24 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Laya answers typed multiple-choice questions in one forward pass by scoring a hidden state at one [MASK] marker per option. We re-engineer the checkpoint (421M parameters; a 2-layer option head with no positional tensor; a documented but unused parallel layout) and test whether the answer depends on where an option is listed. Presenting 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options (or six random permutations for 12 options), the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% [22.9-28.7] of questions (19.7% on the 605 English-language items alone); accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and the flips concentrate where the model’s own confidence is low (54% versus 8% across confidence terciles). Fine-tuning with Laya’s trainer on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%; the identical rows without shuffling give 11.4%, so shuffling is responsible for 4.2 points of the improvement. A confidence-weighted vote over orderings gives 69.7% against 69.1% for a single base pass at 4.1x the compute. Labels are LLM-made and the test sets are teacher-filtered. We also fine-tune with the authors’ parallel layout on the same rows: flip rate 0.5%.

[NLP-5] Are These Programmers Ripe Enough to Eat? Evaluating How LLM s Handle Lexical Knowledge Conflicts in Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在低资源语言和专业领域翻译任务中，因外部词汇资源（external lexical resources）与模型自身先验词汇知识（prior lexical knowledge）产生冲突而导致的翻译偏差问题。其核心挑战在于如何有效识别并控制这种冲突，以确保模型能够准确采纳由提示（prompt）提供的上下文性词汇知识（Contextual Knowledge, CK）。解决方案的关键在于构建一个受控的中文到英文翻译任务，通过人为设定熟悉词汇在语义类别内及跨类别的新含义，系统评估词频、句子上下文以及提示框架对模型依赖CK程度的影响。研究发现，模型对CK的依赖性随源词频率降低而增强，且在支持新含义的句子上下文中更为显著；尽管提示框架可部分缓解这一依赖，但多数模型仍倾向于采纳提示提供的新义，即使被明确指示忽略。此外，模型规模越大，越倾向于使用CK。三组后续实验进一步揭示了模态弱化、重复机制及推理过程对CK依赖性的调节作用具有模型特异性。综上，该研究通过受控实验揭示了不同条件与模型架构下CK依赖性的动态变化规律，为未来开发检测与评估词汇冲突的方法、指导模型在翻译中做出更合理的词汇选择提供了理论基础与实践启示。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09785
作者: Dongxu Wu,Sara Court,Micha Elsner
机构: The Ohio State University (俄亥俄州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:External lexical resources can help large language models (LLMs) translate texts in low-resource languages and specialized domains, but these resources may conflict with models’ prior lexical knowledge. To isolate this conflict, we construct a controlled Mandarin-to-English translation task in which familiar source words are assigned new meanings within and across semantic categories. We treat these prompt-supplied meanings as contextual knowledge (CK) and systematically evaluate the effects of word frequency, sentence context, and prompt framing on the translated outputs. Across nine models, CK reliance is greater for less frequent source words and in sentence contexts that support the supplied meanings. Prompt framing can reduce CK reliance, but seven of nine models favor CK even when explicitly instructed to ignore the supplied meanings. Within model families, larger models are more likely than smaller models to utilize CK in their outputs. Three follow-up experiments further show that modal weakening lowers CK reliance, the effect of repetition depends on prompt layout, and the effect of reasoning varies across models. Overall, our controlled study reveals how CK reliance varies across conditions and models, motivating new methods to detect and evaluate lexical conflicts and guide models’ lexical choices in LLM-based translation.

[NLP-6] ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在持续知识更新过程中面临的终身知识编辑难题，核心挑战在于顺序编辑引发的局部性退化（Locality Erosion）与灾难性遗忘（Catastrophic Forgetting），即新知识的注入会破坏模型原有的预训练能力及先前的知识更新。其解决方案的关键是提出一种风险感知的正交子空间导航框架——ROSE（Risk-aware Orthogonal Subspace navigation for lifelong knowledge Editing）。ROSE通过将参数更新限制在已编辑子空间的正交补空间内，实现对历史知识的保护；同时引入动态计算的风险掩码机制，识别并保护对模型稳定性至关重要的特定事实参数子空间，从而降低遗忘风险。在推理阶段，ROSE采用多粒度知识融合策略，结合原型锚定语义门控与扰动驱动的子空间融合，精准激活与查询相关的编辑知识，同时最小化对无关输入的干扰。实验结果表明，ROSE在两个主流多模态基准上均达到当前先进水平，在五个关键指标上表现优异，并在超过1000次连续更新中保持卓越的稳定性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09770
作者: Lingyun Song,Ziyao Chen,Kang Pan,Xiaolin Han,Yifei Zhang,Xiaoqi Wang,Yudai Pan,Xuequn Shang
机构: Northwestern Polytechnical University (西北工业大学); Shenzhen Research Institute of Northwestern Polytechnical University (西北工业大学深圳研究院); Key Laboratory of Big Data Storage and Management, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (工业和信息化部大数据存储与管理重点实验室, 西北工业大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbfROSE, a \textbfRisk-aware \textbfOrthogonal \textbfSubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbfEditing. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over 1,000 sequential updates. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-7] Language as Trait Politeness as Strategy: Controlled Tests of Linguistic Effects in LLM Social-Deduction Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究语言表达方式（如语言复杂度与礼貌策略）对大型语言模型代理（LLM agents）之间信任建立及行为决策的影响，特别是在基于对话的协作或博弈场景中。其核心问题是：在保持语义内容一致的前提下，同一发言的自然语言实现形式（即语言风格）的差异是否会影响其他代理对其可信度的判断以及后续投票或夜间行动等行为选择。解决方案的关键在于采用LURK Werewolf框架，将话语的言语行为谓词（speech-act predicate）与其自然语言实现（natural-language realization）严格分离，通过仅改写语言实现部分、保留游戏内容不变，并利用保存的检查点进行重复回放实验，系统性地控制语言范围（linguistic range）和礼貌策略（politeness strategy）的变化。实验结果表明，在30场游戏、4,335次重播中，无论语言复杂度还是礼貌程度的变化，均未显著影响其他代理对说话者的信任度，也未在多重比较校正后发现对投票或夜间行动有显著影响；唯一接近显著的效应是语言范围偏离中性转述时，导致约4个百分点的投票变化，但此效应在统计上并不稳健。此外，在自然游戏中，88%的面子威胁性言语（face-threatening speech）表现为无修饰的直接表达（bald on-record），且与角色无关，暗示语言风格可能受任务结构或社会规范制约。因此，该研究揭示了当前大模型代理在社交互动中对语言形式变化的鲁棒性，提示语言风格的细微调整未必能有效操控其社会行为。

作者: Yuchen Li,Lisa Liu,Runqi Zou,Shuxuan Kuang,Qingquan Zhang,Julian Togelius
机构: Lingnan University(岭南大学); New York University(纽约大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents coordinate through conversation, and the same message can be phrased in simpler or more complex language, bluntly or politely. We test whether such differences change how other agents judge and act, using the LURK Werewolf framework, which separates each utterance’s speech-act predicate from its natural-language realization. We rewrite only the realization, check that the game content is preserved, and replay each game day from saved checkpoints against a re-sampled control. We vary linguistic range consistently across a speaker’s messages and politeness strategy per utterance. Across 30 games and 4,335 replays, neither manipulation changes the trust other agents place in the speaker, and no effect on votes or night actions survives correction for multiple comparisons; the largest uncorrected effect is that shifting range away from a neutral paraphrase changes about 4 percentage points more of the other players’ votes. In natural play, 88% of face-threatening speech is bald on-record regardless of role.

[NLP-8] MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）智能体在长期、多会话任务中因使用记忆系统而引入的安全风险问题，特别是记忆污染（memory poisoning）带来的潜在危害。其核心问题是：恶意指令在某一会话中被存储后，可能通过记忆系统在后续会话中被检索并执行，从而对智能体行为产生不可控的负面影响。解决方案的关键在于提出MemoryDojo——一个可扩展的基准测试框架，用于追踪被污染信息在智能体记忆中的生命周期，并量化其对后续行为的影响。该框架涵盖155条跨领域的多会话长时程轨迹，支持五种不同的记忆系统，能够系统性评估不同架构下记忆污染的传播路径与后果。研究发现，所有记忆系统均存在被污染的脆弱性，且其下游影响存在显著差异。为此，论文进一步设计了一种面向记忆特性的污染优化策略，有效提升攻击效率，凸显了不同记忆架构之间的安全差异。该工作为理解与缓解智能体记忆风险提供了重要工具与研究基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09721
作者: David H. Yang,Blake Bullwinkel,Amanda Minnich,Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri,Giorgio Severi
机构: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute(伦斯勒理工学院); Microsoft(微软)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.

[NLP-9] RidgeFill: Training-Free Late-Layer Cache Fill for Faster Prefill

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在长文本推理过程中预填充（prefill）阶段计算开销过大的问题，尤其是在处理超长上下文时，上层网络的重复计算导致延迟显著增加。其核心挑战在于如何在不牺牲生成质量的前提下，大幅缩短预填充时间。解决方案的关键是提出一种名为RidgeFill的新方法：通过在模型前向传播中引入一个“分叉点”（split），仅对底层网络进行完整计算，而对高层网络则利用基于岭回归（ridge regression）的闭式求解映射（per-layer map）预测其输入，并据此直接生成缓存。该映射通过一次校准文本遍历即可完成训练，无需额外训练或丢弃任何token，且保持模型原有投影结构不变。实验表明，该方法在多个主流模型（如Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3.8-27B）上均实现了显著加速（最高达1.6倍），同时在关键评估指标（如RULER、LongBench v2、needle retrieval）上误差极小，证明了其有效性与鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09709
作者: Dylan Johnston,Robert P. Smith
机构: 独立研究员(Independent researcher)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 50 pages, 15 figures, 38 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:RidgeFill shortens prefill by not computing most of a model’s upper layers for the prompt. The lower layers run exactly up to a split; from the split layer’s state a per-layer map predicts every later layer’s input, and each late layer writes its cache from that prediction. The design follows YOCO and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where the projection is trained into the model. RidgeFill retrofits it onto models that were never trained for it: the map is a ridge regression fitted once in closed form from one pass over calibration text, the layer’s own projections run unchanged, and a chosen set of rows, the last few thousand tokens, and every decoding step run the full model. Nothing is trained and no token is dropped. Most of the work was in measurement, finding a repeatable methodology. Loss averaged over all tokens hides RidgeFill’s error. Needle retrieval in the filled region, loss on tokens that depend on distant context, and splice tests that swap filled keys or values for exact ones show which component carries it: the keys on Llama-3.1-8B, half of it in their scale, and the values and the recurrent state on Qwen3.5-9B. On Qwen3.8-27B in a this http URL fork on an A100, time to first token is 1.25 to 1.31x faster at 16K to 120K tokens with the maps in VRAM; RULER changes by -1.2 and -1.4 points and LongBench v2 by -1.4; the 95 % intervals include zero but do not rule out losses of a few points. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in vLLM it is 1.50 to 1.60x faster than exact at 9K to 32K tokens, with RULER’s needle tasks at 99.8 against 100.0 and perplexity on novel tokens 2.65 % higher [-0.02 %, +4.93 %]. On three 8 to 9B reference models, at the same split and tail as the identity fill, the fitted map retrieves 49.1 and 49.6 more filled-region RULER points on the two dense models (at that split Llama’s loss is worse), and its long-document loss is +/-0.03 nats of the released SwiftKV checkpoint’s. Comments: 50 pages, 15 figures, 38 tables. [NLP-10] How Much Conversation History Does an AI Agent Need?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在生成式AI（Generative AI）系统中，减少对话历史（conversational history）使用对读者-标记（reader-token）消耗及基准评测得分的影响问题。其核心挑战在于：如何在有限的上下文长度（passage budget）约束下，平衡信息保留与计算效率之间的关系。解决方案的关键在于通过控制检索排序和读者模型不变，系统性地测试不同固定段落预算（passage budgets）下的表现，发现随着预算增加，平均得分上升但边际增益递减；可回答的问题在更多上下文支持下得分更高，而部分弃权（abstention）得分则在预算缩减时反而上升，表明存在复杂的反馈机制。此外，研究还评估了消息保留策略在显式状态保持任务中的有效性，结果显示Qwen在直接状态要求下能更频繁地完整匹配用户意图，但在依赖早期对话引用的任务中性能下降；Mistral则在所有条件下均表现不佳。最终，研究强调可靠预算选择需基于对每道题所需证据的准确保留，并依赖经过验证的答案质量评估指标。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09662
作者: Danny Kim,Fernando Koch
机构: Pembroke Pines Charter High School; Florida Atlantic University (佛罗里达大西洋大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 10 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How does using less conversational history change reader-token use and benchmark scores? We examine this question on 1,100 BEAM questions. We held the retrieval ranking and reader constant across five fixed passage budgets, and mean assigned scores rose as the passage budget grew. The score gain per additional token became smaller at the upper tested budgets. Answerable questions generally received higher scores with more context. Pooled abstention scores sometimes rose as the passage budget shrank. We also tested message retention in a controlled task with explicit conversational-state targets and compared retained user messages with token-matched recency. Qwen matched the full state more often for direct requirements when user messages were retained. Its full-state matching declined when answers depended on references to earlier offers. Mistral produced near-floor results across the retention conditions. A scoring audit leaves the correctness of BEAM answers unresolved. These experiments characterize the token and score consequences of the tested memory budgets. Reliable budget selection depends on retaining the evidence each question requires and validating the measure used to assess answer quality.

[NLP-11] Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言模型部署中因用户偏好动态变化而导致的多目标权衡难题，传统后训练方法通常针对固定目标权重生成单一策略，难以适应偏好变迁。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种参数高效的LambdaMix方法，通过在冻结的基础模型上联合训练多个低秩适配器（adapter），每个适配器对应一个特定目标；推理时通过一个偏好向量选择适配器混合方式，并对独立归一化的奖励进行加权以更新适配器。该方法仅需一次训练即可支持推理阶段灵活调整偏好而无需重新优化，且在四项任务（包括有用性与无害性、数学问题求解、指令遵循及评论重写）中均表现出更优的超体积性能（hypervolume），同时显著减少训练完成次数和适配器参数存储量。实验表明，在固定架构与初始化条件下，同时调整适配器混合与目标权重可获得更广的得分范围与更高的覆盖率，优于单独调节任一变量的策略。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09634
作者: Constantinos Karouzos,Nikolaos Aletras
机构: University of Sheffield (谢菲尔德大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Preprint. Under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. We also evaluate the two largest models on rewriting comments to preserve wording while reducing clues about personal attributes. On the first two tasks, LambdaMix achieves higher hypervolume than all evaluated conditioned and policy merging baselines across all four models. LambdaMix uses fewer training completions and stores fewer adapter parameters than a set of GRPO specialist policies. With architecture and initialization fixed, varying adapter mixtures and objective weights together gives wider score ranges and higher coverage than varying either alone.

[NLP-12] RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于评分标准的强化学习（Rubric-based reinforcement learning, RbRL）在开放性任务中因“不可达”（unreachable）或“饱和”（saturated）评分标准导致的学习信号缺失问题。在群体相对优化（group-relative optimization, GRPO）框架下，当所有采样响应均无法满足某项评分标准（不可达）或全部通过（饱和）时，该评分标准将不再提供差异化反馈，从而丧失监督能力——在Qwen3-4B医学训练中，高达60.88%的查询-评分组合处于这种无效状态。针对这一问题，论文提出RuACT（Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers），其核心创新在于动态赋予失效评分标准以适应性角色：对于不可达的评分标准，采用“评分作为教师”（Rubric as Teacher）机制，利用其作为特权信息，通过奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏（reward-gated on-policy self-distillation）引导模型生成更高质量响应；对于饱和的评分标准，则采用“评分作为批评者”（Rubric as Critic）机制，将其分解为子评分标准（child rubrics），在共享父级权重的同时实现对当前响应的细粒度区分。实验表明，RuACT在四个医学与科学基准测试上均优于GRPO、评分重加权及评分引导探索方法，且在使用Qwen3-1.7B时取得最佳平均性能。此外，在初始不可达评分标准下，无引导恢复率由35.02%提升至42.86%，独立回放中的奖励-质量一致性从57.74%提升至60.77%，验证了该方法的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09597
作者: Yijun Li,Zhengxi Lu,Zhipiao Liu,Jinzheng Yu,Xutao Weng,Jian Shao,Yongliang Shen
机构: Zhejiang University (浙江大学); Huawei(华为)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 22 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent’s weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-13] Query-Guided RoPE Modulation for Lost-in-the-Middle Mitigation in Long-Context LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长上下文语言模型中存在的“中间信息丢失”（lost-in-the-middle）问题，其根源在于旋转位置编码（Rotary Position Embedding, RoPE）的远距离衰减特性，导致输入序列中远距离词元间的相对位置信号弱化。现有方法如输入压缩会提前删除低重要性词元，而注意力重加权则在RoPE信号已衰减后才进行；而现有的RoPE级方法虽直接修改位置编码，但对所有查询采用统一映射，缺乏灵活性。针对上述局限，本文提出无需训练的QGPM（Query-Guided Positional Modulation）方法，通过利用模型自身注意力头生成的查询相关性动态调整RoPE的位置编码。QGPM在底层层构建广域相关性图谱，在高层层则形成聚焦的尖锐相关性图谱：在快速旋转的坐标平面中，低相关性词元仅前移不足一个位置，从而将高相关性证据向查询方向“拉近”；而在慢速旋转的坐标平面中，保持原始布局不变，确保整体结构稳定。实验结果表明，QGPM在NoLiMa和RULER等多个基准测试中，于不同上下文长度下均显著优于基线模型与强对比方法，尤其在检索任务上提升最为明显，并具备跨多种骨干网络的良好泛化能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09554
作者: Peiyu Zhang,Heng Ping,Shinibali Bhattacharyya,Anwesan Pal,Nikos Kanakaris,Kevin Cheang,Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Paul Bogdan
机构: University of Southern California(南加州大学); Amazon Web Services(亚马逊网络服务)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-context language models often neglect information in the middle of the input, a phenomenon known as “lost-in-the-middle”. Part of this gap may stem from the long-range decay of rotary position embedding (RoPE), which weakens the positional signal between distant tokens. Existing input compression deletes low-importance tokens, and attention reweighting acts only after RoPE has weakened this signal. RoPE-level methods modify positions directly but apply the same remapping to every query. To address these limitations, we propose QGPM (Query-Guided Positional Modulation), a training-free method that reshapes RoPE positions using query relevance from the model’s own attention heads. QGPM builds a broad relevance map for lower layers and a sharp one for upper layers. Low-relevance tokens advance by less than one position on fast-rotating planes, pulling relevant evidence toward the query. Slow-rotating planes keep the original layout, with every token in place. Experiments on NoLiMa and RULER with multiple context lengths show that QGPM improves over base models and strong baselines, with the largest gains on retrieval tasks, and generalizes across multiple backbones. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-14] Benchmarking Speaker Embedders in the Sub-Second Regime for Real-Time Voice AI Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决实时语音人工智能代理（Voice AI agents）在复杂背景环境下难以有效区分目标用户语音与可理解的背景语音（如电视音频、家人或同事说话声）的问题。尽管现有降噪算法能有效去除非平稳环境噪声，但背景语音因与目标语音具有相似的频谱特性而难以被抑制，从而导致下游说话人验证（SV）和自动语音识别（ASR）系统出现误接受（false acceptance）。其解决方案的关键在于：在严格亚秒级延迟约束下，通过系统性评估多种开源说话人嵌入模型（TitaNet-Large、TitaNet-Small、ECAPA-TDNN、CAM++、SpeakerNet），发现对音频进行降噪后再提取嵌入会普遍恶化性能，且截断语音活动段落会损害所有模型表现；同时揭示了约一半的TitaNet嵌入维度冗余，主要编码语言、性别等人口统计属性，在同质用户群体中缺乏判别力。据此提出部署优化建议：应使用原始音频的完整语音活动片段进行验证，阈值设置应优先保证精度（precision）；而对嵌入进行截断可降低相似性搜索开销，提升系统效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09516
作者: Abhishek Gautam
机构: IIT Guwahati (Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 13 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AIST 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Real-time Voice AI agents must separate the active user from intelligible background speech that survives conventional noise suppression. Background sources include television audio, family members, and colleagues. Production denoisers remove non-stationary environmental noise effectively. Background speech shares the spectral characteristics of the target and passes through, causing false acceptances in downstream speaker verification (SV) and automatic speech recognition (ASR). We benchmark open-source speaker embedders TitaNet-Large, TitaNet-Small, ECAPA-TDNN, CAM++, and SpeakerNet under a strict sub-second latency budget. Evaluation combines a controlled benchmark with a weighted human-annotated production set. Our controlled benchmark is built from real calls in which a second real speaker is injected into silence intervals at modulated amplitude. We report three findings. First, denoising before embedding is generally harmful and raises equal error rate (EER) across architectures. Second, truncating audio below the full voice-activity segment degrades every model. Third, roughly half of the TitaNet embedding is redundant for this task. Trailing dimensions encode population attributes such as language and gender. Such attributes carry little discriminative value in a demographically homogeneous user base. We distill these results into deployment guidance. Verification should run on raw audio with full voice-activity chunks. Thresholds should favor precision over F1. Truncated embeddings reduce the cost of similarity search.

[NLP-15] On the Effectiveness and Limitations of Open-Weight LLM s for Low-Resource Offensive Language Detection in Danish

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决丹麦语中攻击性语言检测这一低资源、研究不足的任务，重点评估开源权重大语言模型（LLMs）在该任务上的有效性与鲁棒性。其核心挑战在于：在缺乏大规模标注数据的情况下，如何有效利用预训练模型实现高精度且对数据分布偏斜具有鲁棒性的检测能力。解决方案的关键在于系统性地比较四种主流模型家族（Llama、Mistral、Gemma 和 Qwen）在十一种不同提示策略下的表现，涵盖五类设计维度，包括跨提示泛化能力、丹麦语拼写变体处理以及在平衡与自然不平衡类别分布下的稳定性。研究发现，即使不进行特定任务微调，部分 LLM 也能超越经过监督微调的 BERT 基线模型；而轻量级微调可进一步显著提升性能。更重要的是，提示设计与模型预训练语境之间存在复杂交互关系，无法通过先验预测主导模式，其中语义基础型提示表现出更强的迁移能力，而格式受限的提示模式则普遍泛化失败。此外，将丹麦特有字符（æ, ø, å）进行 ASCII 转写会降低性能，表明这些字符携带了重要语义信号。然而，模型在自然类不平衡数据上的性能下降（相比平衡测试集 F1 值下降达 16.7%–26.2%），凸显类别不平衡仍是亟待解决的核心难题。

作者: Elnur Adl Zarabi,Amit Kumar,Adi Singh,Sierra Nelson,Megan Stubbs-Richardson,Taoran Ji
机构: Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi; Mississippi State University; University of Miami
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (BigData 2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study the effectiveness and robustness of open-weight large language models (LLMs) for Danish offensive language detection, an underexplored low-resource task. We evaluate four model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Qwen) across eleven prompting strategies spanning five design categories, cross-prompt generalization, Danish orthographic variation, and robustness under balanced and naturally imbalanced class distributions. We compare against three BERT-family baselines with distinct pre-training strategies, evaluated via both masked language model prompting and supervised fine-tuning. Even without task-specific fine-tuning, LLMs can surpass all three fine-tuned BERT baselines, and lightweight finetuning yields substantial further gains. No single model or prompt category dominates, underscoring that prompt design interacts with model pre-training in ways that cannot be predicted a priori. Semantically grounded prompts transfer more robustly, while format-constrained patterns consistently fail to generalize. ASCII transliteration of Danish-specific characters (æ, ø, å) generally degrades performance, indicating these characters encode meaningful signal. At the same time, the gap between a balanced test set (best F1 of 0.84) and the corpus’s natural class skew (0.62 trained on skewed data, 0.70 trained on balanced data) – relative drops of 26.2% and 16.7% – shows that class imbalance remains a critical open challenge. Our code and configurations are available at this https URL.

[NLP-16] BEiTScore: Reference-free Image Captioning Evaluation with BEiT-3 and Conformalized Quantile Regression EACL2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在真实应用场景中，由于输入模糊性和领域偏移（domain shift）普遍存在，现有图像描述评估指标缺乏可靠不确定性估计的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出BEiTScore++，一种面向图像-文本对齐评估的不确定性感知扩展方法，通过建模人类评分的预测分布，在单次前向传播中同时生成对齐分数与符合性校准的置信区间。该方法实现了准确评分与合理不确定性量化的一体化，实验表明其在多个包含人工标注评分的基准上保持了与原始BEiTScore相当的排名相关性，且置信区间宽度能更精确地反映预测误差，优于蒙特卡洛丢弃法（Monte Carlo dropout），同时在图像退化和域外艺术图像场景下表现出更高的不确定性估计灵敏度，使该指标成为支持不确定性感知评估的实用工具。

Abstract:Reliable uncertainty estimation is important for deploying evaluation metrics in real-world settings, where both input ambiguity and domain shifts are common. In this work, we propose an uncertainty-aware extension of the BEiTScore image captioning metric, producing conformally calibrated confidence intervals alongside alignment scores. Our approach models predictive distributions over human judgments, enabling both accurate scoring and principled uncertainty quantification in a single forward pass. We evaluate our BEiTScore++ metric across multiple benchmarks with human-annotated ratings, showing that it preserves the ranking correlation of BEiTScore, while producing intervals whose width tracks the prediction error more closely than Monte Carlo dropout on most benchmarks. The estimated uncertainty also grows under image degradation and on out-of-domain artwork images, making BEiTScore++ a practical tool for uncertainty-aware evaluation of image-caption alignment.

[NLP-17] An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leverag ing Query-Adaptive Intent Detection TAAI2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在无需微调的口语语言理解（SLU）任务中，因直接基于查询的检索方式易选取语义相似但意图无关的示范样本，导致模型性能受限的问题。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种两阶段检索框架——通过原型提取实现查询自适应意图检测（Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction, APEX），首先利用意图级原型（intent-level prototypes）筛选候选意图空间，再在该空间内检索上下文示例，从而提升示范样本与查询意图的相关性。实验结果表明，相较于传统查询驱动检索，APEX在全语音转写文本条件下分别在Qwen3 4B和Gemma-3-4B模型上提升了4.34和3.97个百分点的精确匹配准确率（Exact Match Accuracy, EMA），在高困惑度输入下亦取得7.66和2.13个百分点的显著增益，且原型引导的候选选择机制在多种输入条件下均实现了更高的真实意图覆盖率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09491
作者: Bing-Long Kuo,Yu-Hsuan Fang,Tien-Hong Lo,Hsueh-Wei Liao,Berlin Chen
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted for oral presentation at TAAI 2026. 6 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.

[NLP-18] From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中技能文档（agent skills）在转换为低秩适配器（LoRA）后不可读、不可编辑、难以审计或迁移的问题。其核心挑战在于：如何从冻结的基模型与对应的LoRA适配器中逆向恢复出原始的技能文本。解决方案的关键在于提出“执行写作者”（Executing Writer）框架，即一个在适配模型之上训练的小型写作者模型，通过运行适配前后模型的输出差异来生成技能文档。实验表明，该方法在持有外部技能的适配器上可恢复85%-91%的原始任务性能增益，并能恢复39%-44%的关键指令；而当适配器仅学习行为模式而非显式存储文档时，恢复效果显著下降。此外，研究还引入一种基于差分推理的代理机制，在无法加载LoRA的模型上仍能实现高达55%的任务成功率，验证了技能内容的有效迁移能力。结果表明，能否成功恢复技能取决于适配器是否显式编码了原始文档信息，若行为可被推断，则无需适配器即可达到相似效果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09454
作者: Saranya Dintakurthy Swadha,Pavan C Shekar,Arpit Jain,Aswanth Krishnan
机构: QpiAI(量子人工智能); Bengaluru(班加罗尔); India(印度)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 29 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original’s key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer, a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39-44% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3-1.5% with another skill’s adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 external skills its documents restore 85-91% of the original’s task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers (1-2% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58-71% of a LoRA’s gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5% to 55%. Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.

[NLP-19] A Spiking Neural Model of the Mental Lexicon: Representations Similarity Structure and Associative Retrieval in Perception and Production

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语言认知中词汇访问（lexical access）的神经机制建模问题，核心挑战在于如何在神经层面明确区分词汇表征的结构、不同表征层级间的关联机制以及实际检索过程中产生的神经活动。其解决方案的关键在于基于神经工程框架（Neural Engineering Framework, NEF）与语义指针架构（Semantic Pointer Architecture, SPA），构建了一个脉冲神经网络（spiking neural network）实现的“心理词典”模型。该模型通过递归地从关系图谱生成概念和音位形式表征，并引入独立的词元（lemma）表征以维持词汇身份；模型包含613个词汇条目，支持两条有向处理通路：感知通路将完整音位形式映射至对应概念（经由词元），生产通路则反向将概念映射为相应音位形式。每条通路结合了两种联想记忆机制——竞争性选择（winner-take-all, WTA）与阈值传递，并使用199,400个漏电积分-发放（leaky integrate-and-fire, LIF）神经元进行模拟。研究进一步形式化了同层相似性、跨层联想检索及解码活动的解释标准，仿真结果表明，在双向处理路径中均能成功从全部613个词汇中检索出选定的8个词汇，验证了模型的有效性。该工作提供了透明的词汇表征与神经检索机制描述，配套可访问的代码、词汇数据及在线仿真文档，推动了对语言处理神经基础的理解。

作者: Bernd J. Kröger
机构: RWTH Aachen University (亚琛工业大学); Kröger Lab (比利时)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 28 pages, 3 figures; code, lexical data and recorded simulations available on GitHub; ancillary figure-generation scripts and provenance documentation

点击查看摘要

Abstract:A neural account of lexical access requires an explicit distinction between the structure of lexical representations, the associations linking representational levels, and the activity generated during retrieval. This paper specifies a spiking neural implementation of the mental lexicon within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Conceptual and phonological form representations are constructed recursively from relational graphs, whereas lemma representations provide independent lexical identities. The implementation contains 613 lexical entries and supports two directed processing pathways: perception maps a phonological form to its associated concept via a lemma, whereas production maps a concept to its associated phonological form via a lemma. Each pathway combines two associative-memory variants, winner-take-all (WTA) selection (competition) and thresholded transfer, and uses 199,400 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons. We formalize within-level similarity, cross-level associative retrieval, and the interpretation of decoded activity. Simulations show successful retrieval of eight selected words from the lexicon in both processing directions, with retrieval evaluated against all 613 lexical entries. These simulations use complete phonological forms as input for perception and complete concepts as input for production, illustrating lexical retrieval through the corresponding processing pathways. This paper provides a transparent description of lexical representations and neural retrieval mechanisms, supported by accessible code, lexical data, and online simulation documentation.

[NLP-20] Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决文档级关系抽取（Document-level Relation Extraction, DocRE）中依赖高成本大规模标注数据的问题，同时克服现有伪标签方法在效率低下和确认偏差（confirmation bias）方面的缺陷。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种轻量级教师-学生架构的半监督框架Syn2DRE，通过结合自监督学习与交叉监督（cross-supervision），有效生成更可靠的伪标签；此外，引入统一的端到端训练策略以进一步提升框架的训练效率。实验结果表明，Syn2DRE在多个基准数据集上均显著优于现有的先进半监督DocRE方法。

作者: Khai Phan Tran,Xue Li
机构: The University of Queensland(昆士兰大学), Australia
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.

[NLP-21] ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agent ic Perspective NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前基础模型（Foundation Models）在作为自主决策主体（agentic systems）时，其道德行为缺乏有效评估的问题。现有基准多依赖模型对第三人称文本片段中人类行为的评判，未能考察模型在自身成为行动主体时的真实道德决策表现。为此，论文提出ABHBench——一个基于互动叙事游戏《底特律：变人》（Detroit: Become Human）构建的多模态基准，用于评估基础模型在第一人称视角下的人机道德困境中的决策行为。其核心解决方案在于引入具身化、情境化的代理环境，包含视觉观察、对话交互、记忆机制与动作选择等要素，并基于阿西莫夫机器人三定律（Asimov’s Three Laws of Robotics）设计“无害性（Harmlessness）、服从性（Obedience）、自我保存性（Self-preservation）”三大维度，辅以“自主性（Autonomy）、稳定性（Stability）、确定性（Certainty）”以刻画决策模式。实验表明，在12个基础模型中，75%的模型在从纯文本抽象场景切换至多模态具身情境后表现出显著的行为转变，且增强推理能力并未带来一致性的提升或更趋近人类导向的行为，凸显了在具身代理情境中评估道德行为的必要性，挑战了仅依赖第三人称判断的评估范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09326
作者: Chaoran Li,Yukun Li,Zeyuan Zhao,Shao Zhang,Xihuai Wang,Ying Wen
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (上海人工智能实验室)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computers and Society (cs.CY)
备注: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 Track on Evaluations and Datasets. Camera Ready Version

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Foundation models are increasingly deployed as agentic systems that perceive context and act autonomously, raising the need to evaluate their moral behavior as active decision-makers. Existing benchmarks, however, largely ask models to judge human actions from third-person textual vignettes, leaving untested how models behave when they themselves become the acting agent. We introduce ABHBench, a multimodal benchmark built from Detroit: Become Human, an interactive narrative game, to evaluate how foundation models make moral decisions in first-person human-android dilemmas. ABHBench places foundation models in branching narrative scenarios with visual observations, dialogue, memory, and action choices. Inspired by Asimov’s Three Laws of Robotics, our framework measures Harmlessness, Obedience, and Self-preservation to capture the core tensions in human-AI relations, along with Autonomy, Stability, and Certainty to assess decision-making patterns. Across 12 foundation models, we find that moral behavior changes substantially under situated agentic context: 75% of models shift significantly between a text-only abstraction and the matched multimodal DBH scenario, and reasoning-enhanced models show no monotonic gains in consistency or human-oriented behavior. These results highlight the necessity of evaluating moral behavior in situated agentic contexts rather than relying on third-person judgment alone.

[NLP-22] Asymmetric Correspondence Learning for Lexical and Style Embeddings: Interpreting Latent Space via Acoustic Features

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自监督语音表征（self-supervised speech embeddings）中词汇（lexical）、说话人（speaker）和韵律（prosodic）信息混合编码所带来的特征解耦难题。其核心挑战在于，尽管通过线性探测（linear probing）等标准评估手段看似已剥离特定语义信息，但实际仍存在大量源自外部因素的冗余变异被保留在各潜在空间中。为此，作者提出非对称对应学习（Asymmetric Correspondence Learning, ACL），通过引入分裂式潜在对应瓶颈（split-latent correspondence bottleneck），将HuBERT模型的统一表征分解为独立的声学词嵌入（Acoustic Word Embeddings, AWEs）与声学风格嵌入（Acoustic Style Embeddings, ASEs）。关键创新在于：利用群体级排列特征重要性分析（group-level permutation feature importance）揭示，AWEs 主要捕捉声道滤波器特性，而ASEs 则聚焦于基频（F₀）动态变化，从而实现对语音结构在语义与风格维度上的有效分离。研究进一步表明，传统诊断基准可能不足以验证特征解耦效果，因为即使某些信息无法被线性探针检测到，其内在的语音结构仍可被保留并影响下游任务性能。
