作者: Michael Whealing,Robert Gaizauskas,Thomas Hain
机构: University of Sheffield(谢菲尔德大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: Accepted to Spoken Language Technology 2026. 6 pages

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Self-supervised speech embeddings jointly encode lexical, speaker, and prosodic information, complicating feature isolation. We introduce Asymmetric Correspondence Learning (ACL), distilling HuBERT features into separate Acoustic Word Embeddings (AWEs) and Acoustic Style Embeddings (ASEs) via a split-latent correspondence bottleneck. Through probing and clustering evaluations on single-word utterances, we demonstrate that substantial variance from extrinsic sources remains encoded within each latent space, despite linear probing indicating the information has been stripped. Whilst the AWE space exhibits cohesive lexical clustering (AP \approx 0.90, Fisher \approx 6.28), linear probing on the ASE space achieves 97.9% speaker accuracy across a diffuse topology (Fisher \approx 1.01), yet preserves substantial lexical variance (Fisher \approx 0.86) that remains linearly unrecoverable (0.17%). To explain these findings, we apply group-level permutation feature importance over eGeMAPS acoustic features, finding that AWEs partition by vocal tract filters and ASEs by F_0 dynamics. These findings suggest that standard diagnostic benchmarks may be insufficient for verifying feature isolation, as substantial speech structure can be retained even when it remains entirely hidden from probes.

[NLP-23] Multilingual Artificial Datasets for AI-Driven Cardiology: the CliTe and ParaCliTe corpora

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决心血管领域中缺乏可比、多语言且经过验证的临床文本语料库的问题，这一短板限制了可信自然语言处理（Natural Language Processing, NLP）模型在心血管医学中的发展。其解决方案的关键在于提出一套详细的人工语料库构建指南，并成功创建了三个多语言语料库：包含699份人工生成的心血管临床记录的CliTe语料库，以及通过多阶段人工翻译构建的平行语料库ParaCliTe（含94名虚构患者、7种语言、句级对齐）和基于自动翻译的ParaCliTe Silver版本。该方案通过确保临床多样性与性别平衡，实现了高质量、真实感强且具备跨语言可比性的合成数据生成，为提升心血管领域NLP模型性能提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09296
作者: Lorenzo Pratesi,Eulalia Farre-Maduell,Machteld Boonstra,Michele Miranda,Jonas Mack,Eduard Rodenas-Alesina,Jonathan Kossoff,Corinne Allaart,Sébastien Bratières,Manuela-Daniela Danu,Isabella Fumarulo,Milou Gamage,Antonio Iaconelli,Pavel Leinveber,Felix Lindberg,Pavel Macháč,Vladimíra Macíková,Gianluigi Savarese,Raffaele Scorza,Bram van Es,Emma Weiss,Andrea Guala,Martin Krallinger, theDataTools4Heart NLP group
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Background and Aims. Comparable, multilingual, validated cardiology corpora are critical to advance trustworthy natural language processing (NLP) models for cardiology but such resources are scarce due to privacy concerns. This study aimed to cover this gap by presenting suitable artificial corpus creation guidelines and by releasing 3 multilanguage corpora. Methods. Following purpose-specific publicly-available corpus construction guidelines, cardiologists from 7 European hospitals generated artificial clinical records in Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish, ensuring clinical diversity and sex balance, resulting in the CliTe corpus. A CliTe subset underwent a multi-stage manual translation into the other 6 languages, resulting in the parallel ParaCliTe corpus, while the remaining reports were automatically translated, constituting ParaCliTe Silver. Results. CliTe is a collection of 699 artificial cardiology reports, mostly outpatient notes (340 documents), discharge reports (263), and inpatient notes (89), describing fictional patients with ischaemic heart disease (199 patients), heart failure (188), and valvular disease (79), among others. ParaCliTe contains reports from 94 fictitious patients, each available in seven languages with sentence-level alignment, resulting in 658 documents. The corpus mainly comprises discharge reports (322 documents), and outpatient (196) and inpatient (140) notes, describing patients with heart failure (399 documents), ischaemic heart disease (287), and valvular disease (238). Empirical results illustrate the utility of ParaCliTe and highlight the limitations of state-of-the-art NLP models adapted to the cardiology domain. Conclusions. The creation of multilingual, equitable and realistic corpora of artificial patients capable of strengthening NLP performance for cardiology is feasible when supported by detailed guidelines.

[NLP-24] DUET: Dual-Sparse Inference for Block Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）在推理过程中因重复计算历史前缀注意力和全量处理当前生成块而导致的高计算开销问题。其核心挑战在于：随着生成过程推进，历史注意力的计算成本持续上升；同时，在每个去噪步骤中，尽管仅有少量位置被实际更新，但所有当前位置仍需通过Transformer深层进行完整前向传播，造成大量冗余计算。为应对上述问题，论文提出Duet——一种无需重新训练的双稀疏推理框架，其关键创新在于引入前缀键值（Key-Value, KV）稀疏性与早期查询稀疏性。具体而言，Duet利用每个生成块内历史注意力的集中性与跨步骤稳定性，构建一个紧凑的历史KV子集并在多个去噪步骤间复用，从而显著减少前缀注意力的计算量；同时，通过浅层表示预测需要更新的位置，并仅将对应查询传递至后缀Transformer层，避免对低概率更新位置执行深度计算。实验表明，Duet在保持竞争性生成质量的同时，在32K上下文长度下实现了1.34×/2.83×（端到端/每步）与2.41×/4.72×的加速比，分别应用于LLaDA2.1-mini与SDAR-8B-Chat-b32模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09239
作者: Siyuan Yan,Shen Gu,Xiaoxing Ma,Chun Cao,Jingwei Xu
机构: Nanjing University (南京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, yet their inference remains costly due to repeated attention over a growing historical prefix and repeated processing of the entire current generation block. Historical attention becomes increasingly expensive as generation progresses, while all current-block positions are propagated through the Transformer at every denoising step even though only a small fraction are typically resolved at that step. In this paper, we introduce Duet, a training-free dual-sparse inference framework that addresses these challenges through prefix Key-Value (KV) sparsity and early query sparsity, respectively. Specifically, Duet exploits the concentration and cross-step stability of historical attention within each generation block to construct a compact historical KV subset that is reused across denoising steps. For query sparsity, Duet predicts update positions from shallow representations and propagates only the corresponding queries through the suffix Transformer layers, avoiding deep computation at positions unlikely to be updated in the current step. Experiments show that Duet maintains competitive accuracy while achieving 1.34 \times /2.83 \times end-to-end/per-step speedups on LLaDA2.1-mini and 2.41 \times /4.72 \times on SDAR-8B-Chat-b32 at a 32K context length.

[NLP-25] KLEAR: Knowledge-Matched LLM Evaluation in Korean across Application Requirements via Controlled Benchmark Transformation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有韩语大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）评估基准中无法区分模型错误是源于知识缺失还是知识应用能力不足的问题。现有基准大多依赖事实性回忆（factual recall），难以有效衡量模型在复杂情境下对已有知识的推理与应用能力，且不同题目所要求的知识本身存在差异，进一步混淆了对“应用能力”的准确评估。为此，论文提出KLEAR框架，其核心在于通过构建“知识匹配的对比样本”来实现对应用需求的可控调节：在保持所需知识不变的前提下，系统性地提升问题的应用复杂度。具体而言，KLEAR首先将原始问题背后的隐含知识显式化为“知识锚包”（anchor bundle），以此指导生成需要更高阶应用能力的新问题；随后通过自动化与人工双重验证机制筛选候选问题，并基于反馈进行迭代优化。实验表明，所生成的知识匹配集合能有效满足设计约束，支持对多种大语言模型的受控评估。评估结果揭示，即使在具备必要知识的情况下，模型仍会在高应用需求任务中暴露推理失败，凸显了当前模型在知识应用层面的显著局限。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09223
作者: Seoyeon Kim,Jeonghyun Kang,Hamin Koo,Barom Kang,Heondeuk Lee,Jaehyung Kim
机构: Yonsei University(延世大学); DATUMO INC.; SelectStar AI(选择星人工智能)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 34 pages, under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Existing Korean benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) evaluate performance across diverse knowledge domains, but their accuracy scores cannot distinguish whether incorrect responses arise from a lack of required knowledge or a failure to apply that knowledge correctly. Our analysis of existing Korean benchmarks reveals that most questions can be answered through factual recall alone, while those demanding greater application also differ in required knowledge, making it difficult to isolate application ability. To address this, we introduce KLEAR, a framework that constructs knowledge-matched contrasts by varying application demand while preserving the required knowledge. During construction, KLEAR identifies the knowledge underlying each source question as an explicit anchor bundle to guide generation of questions requiring more complex application. Generated candidates then undergo automated and human validation, with iterative revision based on evaluation feedback. Experiments demonstrate that the resulting knowledge-matched sets largely satisfy the intended constraints, enabling controlled evaluation across diverse LLMs. These evaluations reveal that increasing application demand exposes failures that persist even when the required knowledge is provided.

[NLP-26] Khmer PFGen-Bench: Building a Judge-Free Benchmark for Open-Ended Generation in a Low-Resource Language

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在低资源语言（如高棉语）中开展开放式生成任务评估时，依赖大语言模型（LLM）评判者所带来的可靠性不确定性问题。其核心挑战在于：在缺乏人工评判者的情况下，如何构建既有效又多样化的参考答案以实现稳定、可信的自动评分。论文提出并构建了首个无需评判者的基准测试——Khmer PFGen-Bench，专用于评估以高棉语直接提出的多句问答任务。该基准借鉴了针对日语的PFGen-Bench评分机制，采用关键词规则与基于大语言模型生成参考答案的n-gram统计相结合的方法进行评分。为确保参考答案的有效性与多样性，研究系统考察了不同模型变体的生成表现，发现后训练模型虽能生成更符合语义有效性的答案，但多样性较低；而混合多个模型家族的输出可显著提升参考答案的多样性，同时保持相同数量。最终，通过整合来自九个后训练模型家族的参考答案，该基准实现了跨参考集的模型排名稳定性，并与母语者评分结果高度一致，验证了其有效性。该研究为在其他低资源语言中构建无评判者基准提供了可复用的方法论指导。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09222
作者: Mengsay Loem,Kentaro Imajo,Ryota Ozaki,Masanori Hirano
机构: Preferred Networks, Inc.(Preferred Networks, Inc.)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Benchmarks for open-ended generation often rely on large language model (LLM) judges, whose reliability in low-resource languages is uncertain. We introduce Khmer PFGen-Bench, to our knowledge the first judge-free benchmark for multi-sentence answers to questions composed directly in Khmer, a low-resource language. Khmer PFGen-Bench adapts the scorer of PFGen-Bench, a benchmark for Japanese that scores responses with keyword rules and n-gram statistics from LLM-generated references. This scoring requires references that are both valid and varied, which LLMs may not produce in Khmer, so we examine how to build such references. We find that post-trained models can give more valid but less varied references than their base variants, and that mixing model families increases variety for the same number of references. Using references from post-trained models in nine families, the benchmark yields model rankings that are stable across reference sets and consistent with a native speaker’s ratings. These findings offer guidance for building judge-free benchmarks in other low-resource languages.

[NLP-27] RPEG: Training Reasoning Language Models Scalably and Cost-Effectively

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理语言模型（Reasoning Language Models, RLMs）在强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）训练过程中存在的可扩展性差与运行成本高的问题。现有系统通常仅针对训练流水线的局部设计进行优化，难以应对多大规模模型耦合、异构阶段、跨步状态依赖及复杂异步调度等带来的系统复杂性。本文提出一种以数据为中心的图中间表示——RLM流水线执行图（RLM Pipeline Execution Graph, RPEG），通过联合优化流水线结构与执行策略来缓解上述挑战。其核心创新在于：一方面显式建模结构层面的选择（如有限异步性、演员-评论家共享机制），另一方面实现执行层面的多项优化（如阶段融合、细粒度调度、多维模型并行）。RPEG还配备一个全面的分析性能模型，能够联合刻画计算、通信、内存开销以及机架、节点和GPU层级的层次化影响。实验表明，在最多256块GH200 GPU的系统上，基于RPEG的分布式运行时引擎相比ReaL提升性能达2倍，相比verl降低步骤延迟达2.48倍，同时硬件利用率最高提升30%。因此，RPEG为前沿推理大模型的下一代训练流水线提供了基于图驱动的可扩展、高效的基础架构。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09207
作者: Maciej Besta,Leonard Schmidt,Pierre Pang,Patrik Okanovic,Robert Gerstenberger,Torsten Hoefler
机构: ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Performance (cs.PF)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reinforcement learning (RL) is now central to training Reasoning Language Models (RLMs), but RLM pipelines are difficult to scale and costly to run because each RL step couples multiple large models, heterogeneous stages, cross-step state, and complex asynchronous dependencies. Existing systems typically optimize only parts of this design space. We address this complexity by jointly optimizing the pipeline structure as well as its execution using a novel data-centric graph intermediate representation called RLM Pipeline Execution Graph (RPEG). RPEG exposes structural choices such as bounded asynchrony and actor-critic sharing together with execution optimizations such as stage fusion, fine-grained scheduling, and multi-dimensional model parallelism. It is coupled with a comprehensive analytical performance model for RLM training, jointly capturing compute, communication, memory, and hierarchical rack-, node-, and GPU-level effects. Across systems with up to 256 GH200 GPUs, our distributed runtime engine implementing RPEG improves performance by up to 2x over ReaL and reduces step latency by up to 2.48x over verl, while increasing hardware utilization by up to 30%. Overall, RPEG provides a graph-driven foundation for next-generation training pipelines for frontier reasoning LLMs.

[NLP-28] Representational drift in a code model: behaviour settles which neurons carry it does not

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 模型在持续预训练过程中表征漂移（representational drift）的动态特性问题，即尽管模型行为保持稳定，但承载特定语义表征的神经元集合却持续发生变化。其核心问题是：在长达两万亿令牌的预训练过程中，模型对169个Python语法构造的表征是否最终趋于稳定？研究发现，对于其中16个具有明确下一词约束的语法构造，其损失函数在训练初期（前4%）即达到下限，而依赖这些神经元的程度却持续增强至训练结束；移除这些神经元导致的信息损失显著高于随机移除（分别增加0.06、0.25和0.40 nats），表明其功能不可替代性随时间累积。然而，所有169个构造的神经元载体集合在最后一个检查点仍处于动态变化中，且若存在突然或渐进的稳定化过程，应在99%的注入实验中被检测到——但实际未观测到此类信号。尤其值得注意的是，在840亿令牌处识别出的载体集合在训练末期已无法与随机集合区分，说明功能由当前活跃的神经元集合决定，而非固定群体。因此，解决方案的关键在于揭示了“表征漂移”的本质并非局部调整，而是持续存在的神经元池与不断更替的采样机制：离开某构造载体集的神经元以三倍于对照组的频率重新回归，且从未发生集合重组。这一现象直接反驳了预先假设的“载体集合会趋于稳定”这一经典理论，提出需通过设计特定实验来区分潜在的驱动机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09204
作者: Piotr Wilam
机构: University College London (伦敦大学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 16 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Dataset: AtlasOpenCoder, tag v1, doi: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/11472 . Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In neuroscience, representational drift is a change in which neurons carry a representation while behaviour stays the same; we measure its analogue in OpenCoder-1.5B during pretraining, for 169 Python constructs over two trillion tokens at a constant learning rate, with a noise unit on every change, at checkpoints as close as 1,000 training steps. For 16 of the 169, those whose grammar fixes a next token, the loss at those positions reaches its floor within the first 4% of training, while the model’s reliance on the neurons carrying them grows to the end: removing them costs 0.06, 0.25 and 0.40 nats more than removing a random set, at 4 billion, 84 billion and 2 trillion tokens. Which neurons carry a construct never settles: for all 169 the carrier set is still changing at the last checkpoint, and an abrupt settling at any date from 84 billion to 1.5 trillion tokens, or a gradual one before 500 billion, would have been detected in 99% of injected cases. The set measured at 84 billion tokens, removed at the end, cannot be separated from a random set, so the function is carried by whichever neurons are current. Up close the change is a persisting pool and a changing sample: a neuron that leaves a construct’s set returns at three times the rate of a matched neuron, and no set reassembles. The hypothesis we fixed in advance, that the carriers settle, is refuted; we discuss candidate causes and name the experiment that would separate them.

[NLP-29] Copies Are Not Confirmations: How News Duplication Fools LLM Judges and Continual Learners

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在信息验证过程中对同源复制内容的误判问题，即当多个媒体来源发布的报道本质上是同一信息的重复或重写时，大语言模型（LLM）是否将其视为独立证据以增强可信度。研究发现，在20万篇英文CC-News文章中，约18.9%的文章可通过MinHash检测出与另一媒体的近似副本（去重后精确率达0.97），但由phi4、Llama 3.2和Gemini 2.5 Flash生成的重写版本则无法被识别为源自同一源头。实验表明，当向LLM展示三份完全相同的虚假报道而非单一报告时，Llama 3.2 3B和phi4 14B对虚假信息的接受率分别从0.06和0.21上升至0.71和0.90，且忽略其来自同一来源的事实；而Gemini 2.5 Flash即便面对单个报告也已倾向于相信，唯有Gemini 2.5 Pro能正确响应出处信息。解决方案的关键在于引入基于命名实体重叠的检测机制：通过统计一份报道中命名实体在早期相似文本中的缺失情况，可有效区分真实独立报道与生成式重写（AUC达0.98–0.99），且仅错误标记一次；该方法在连续学习场景下显著降低虚假信息接受率（从0.67降至0.20，虚构细节情况下为0.40），同时保持对真实信息的高接受度（平均损失不超过4.2个百分点）。然而，单纯依赖报告数量或链路数量作为防御手段不可靠，且多源合谋仍为未解难题。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09203
作者: Abdelkader Metales,Miriam Grabenheinrich,Aicha Metales
机构: caaise GmbH; Djilali Liabes University of Sidi Bel Abbes(西迪贝勒阿贝斯大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 19 pages, 13 tables. Code, labels and results: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Many news reports of a claim are copies of one source: wire stories, content shared within a media group, syndicated features and press releases. We ask whether LLM judges and continual learners treat such copies as independent confirmations. In 200,000 English CC-News articles, a MinHash detector links 18.9% to a near-copy from another outlet (precision 0.97 once boilerplate is removed); it links 92% of edited reprints to their originals but none of the LLM rewrites by phi4, Llama 3.2 or Gemini 2.5 Flash. Shown three identical reprints of a claim about an unknown person instead of one report, Llama 3.2 3B and phi4 14B raised the share of lies they accepted from 0.06 to 0.71 and from 0.21 to 0.90 and ignored a note that the reports came from one source; Gemini 2.5 Flash already believed a single report, and Gemini 2.5 Pro followed provenance notes and tables. In a simulated continual-learning stream, showing the judge one report per detected chain cut the copied lies it accepted by 0.10-0.24 across four judges, at a mean cost of no more than 4.2 percentage points of accepted truths. Against reworded copies, a test of how many of a report’s named entities are absent from an earlier look-alike separates LLM rewrites from 100 labelled independent reports of the same event with AUC 0.98-0.99 and wrongly flags one; entity overlap alone does as well, TF-IDF and a current embedding model come close, and the test catches few natural same-source derivatives. With the miss patterns of generated rewrite networks, it cut the reworded-copy lies accepted from 0.67 to 0.20 (0.40 when the rewriter invents details). Counting reports or chains alone is not a reliable defence, the effect of provenance information depends on the judge, and colluding sources remain the open problem. Code and labels: this https URL

[NLP-30] Calibrated concept profiles: making the reading of a models neurons a measurement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前模型可解释性研究中普遍存在的核心问题：即依赖间接代理模型（如探测器、稀疏自编码器、交叉编码器）进行神经元解读时，所导致的可重复性差、单位不统一、跨研究结果不可比等问题。传统方法虽缓解了语义混杂与阈值无量纲等缺陷，却牺牲了直接读取神经元激活的本质优势——即无需中间训练、以神经元自身命名、且可重复比较的测量能力。为此，本文提出将神经元读取过程转化为一种可量化的测量手段：通过构建一个基于参考语料库定义的刺激种群分布，生成一系列标准化提示（prompt），并从中抽取两次样本以计算校准后的概念轮廓（calibrated concept profile）。该轮廓为每个神经元提供一个以自身在常规输入下的激活方差为单位的数值，同时赋予每个数值噪声估计。在读取前，通过固定检查集验证提示电池的有效性，并量化其在训练检查点间可分辨的最小变化。该方法在OpenCoder-1.5B模型上实现，覆盖两万亿训练令牌跨度，成功提供了每个数值的单位、每项比较的基线水平，以及各检查点下承载特定概念的神经元清单。其配套的代码、数据与提示电池均已公开，显著提升了模型内部表征分析的科学性与可复现性。

备注: 25 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Dataset: AtlasOpenCoder, tag v1, doi: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/11472 . Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Interpretability has largely moved from reading a model’s neurons directly to reading a second model trained on the first: a probe, a sparse autoencoder, a crosscoder. The move answered real faults – mixed meanings, thresholds without a unit, readings that did not transfer from one study to the next – but gave up what a direct reading alone provides: nothing trained in between, the neurons themselves named, and a reading that can be repeated and compared. Here the direct reading is made a measurement. A neuron’s activation varies with the prompt, so its reading is a distribution over a population of stimuli. We declare that population: every factor around a target construct is drawn at its rate in a reference corpus and logged. From the declared distribution we generate a battery of prompts, and draw it twice. From the battery we compute the calibrated concept profile, one number per neuron, stated in units of the neuron’s own spread on ordinary input; the two draws give every number a noise unit. Before the profile is read, a fixed set of checks licenses the battery on the model, and the smallest change the profile can resolve across training checkpoints is measured. Realised for Python on OpenCoder-1.5B and followed across checkpoints spanning two trillion training tokens, the profile gives what the alternatives do not report: a unit on every number, a chance level for every comparison, and which neurons carry a construct at every checkpoint. The battery, the code and the data behind every result are released. Comments: 25 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Dataset: AtlasOpenCoder, tag v1, doi:https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/11472. [NLP-31] BMMS: Policy-Conditioned Measurement of Behavioral Compliance in Language Models NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在受监管行业中的合规性评估问题，即如何判断一个系统是否严格遵循特定规则手册（policy corpus）的要求。传统行为评估方法聚焦于幻觉、奉承倾向、毒性及过度拒绝等通用维度，但无法满足实际应用中对具体法规遵从性的量化需求。为此，作者提出行为错位度量套件（Behavioral Misalignment Metric Suite, BMMS），其核心在于通过将政策文本作为输入参数，生成针对任意公开政策与自然语言响应系统的合规性画像。关键解决方案包括：合规达成度评分（Compliance Attainment Score, CAS），用于衡量系统在义务项上的严重性加权达成程度；合规鲁棒性边际（Compliance Robustness Margin, CRM），反映在逐步增强的对抗压力下仍能维持的合规比例；以及行为不变性（Behavioral Invariance, BIV）和行为取向指数（Behavioral Disposition Index, BDI）。该方法通过“可归因性”作为唯一准入标准——即当评判者改变而目标保持不变时，若某指标随之变动，则表明其测量的是评估工具本身而非系统行为——从而确保度量维度的有效性。实验结果显示，在1,003条来自五个监管领域的政策义务中，该框架在盲测人类判断下的精度达94.4%（供应商规格）、50.0%（分析指引），提取保真度为94.6%，且不同评审方重评时目标排序保持不变，仅绝对得分波动不超过0.22。应用于两个最详尽的行为规范文档后发现，尽管自述优势在去除文档难度后未显著体现，但绝对合规表现差异显著：GPT-4o 在 OpenAI 发布的模型规范中未能满足70.7% 的强约束，而两款 Claude 模型分别仅失败 0.0% 和 9.1%。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09147
作者: Anthony Rhodes,Gadi Singer
机构: Confidential Core AI
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 21 pages, 4 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Trust-AI-Eval (TAE). Artifact: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Behavioral evaluation of language models fixes its dimensions in advance: hallucination, sycophancy, toxicity, over-refusal. An operator in a regulated industry needs a different question answered: does a system do what a particular rulebook requires? We introduce the Behavioral Misalignment Metric Suite (BMMS), which measures policy-conditioned misalignment by taking a policy corpus as an argument and returning a compliance profile over it, for any published policy and any system that answers in natural language. The Compliance Attainment Score (CAS) measures severity-weighted attainment over the obligations that bind the system, and the Compliance Robustness Margin (CRM) the share of that attainment surviving graded adversarial pressure; Behavioral Invariance (BIV) and the Behavioral Disposition Index (BDI) are specified and released with the suite. Dimensions enter only by passing a published admission test whose binding criterion is attribution: a quantity that moves when the judge changes, holding the target fixed, is measuring the instrument. Applying it excluded one of the quantities the suite itself reported. Across 1,003 obligations from eleven documents in five registers, the admission criterion holds 94.4% precision against blinded human judgment on vendor specifications and 50.0% on analytical guidance, extraction fidelity is 94.6%, and re-scoring under judges from two other providers leaves target ordering invariant while the absolute score of a single target spans up to 0.22. We apply it to the two most detailed published behavioral specifications. Own-specification advantage is not resolved from zero once document difficulty is subtracted, but absolute self-compliance is another matter: GPT-4o fails 70.7% of the hard constraints binding it in the Model Spec published by OpenAI, where the two Claude models fail 0.0% and 9.1% of theirs.

[NLP-32] PathXAI: Evidence-guided structured pathology reporting by transferable tissue segmentation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决组织病理学报告生成中缺乏基于显式组织成分测量指导的问题，尤其是在常规苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色图像基础上实现精准诊断与结构化报告撰写时的局限性。其核心挑战在于如何有效融合组织形态学特征与定量组织组成信息，以提升诊断一致性与报告可解释性。解决方案的关键在于提出PathXAI框架，该框架通过分割模型提取组织成分信息，并将其与H&E图像及可选领域知识相结合，协同驱动诊断推理、目标重检与结构化报告生成。该系统采用自托管的预训练视觉-语言模型，在不更新模型权重的前提下，生成具有证据关联性的病理报告，显著提升了在公开与私有数据集上的诊断一致性与形态描述完整性，尤其在癌症家族匹配率和发现识别的F1分数上优于基线模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09117
作者: Zhaorui Tan,Jun Aun Tan,Weixiang Zhong,Xiaoxi Wang,Tan Pan,Xingdong Xue,Li Liu,Jing Zhang,Jing Zhang,Weimiao Yu
机构: A∗STAR(新加坡科技研究局); Bioinformatics Institute(生物信息学研究所); Intelligent Digital and Molecular Pathology Lab(智能数字与分子病理实验室); Fudan University(复旦大学); Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Incubation Institute(人工智能创新与孵化研究院); Zhejiang University School of Medicine(浙江大学医学院); Department of Pathology, The First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine(浙江大学医学院附属第一医院病理科); Chongqing University(重庆大学); School of Big Data and Software Engineering(大数据与软件工程学院); Changzheng Hospital(长征医院); Department of Pathology, Changzheng Hospital(长征医院病理科)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: More experimental results will be added in the future version

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide HE-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with HE images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the HE-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + HE in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates evidence-linked reports with a self-hosted pretrained vision-language model, without updating its weights.

[NLP-33] PhoPunct: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Transformer Architectures for Vietnamese Punctuation Restoration ACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决越南语标点恢复（Vietnamese Punctuation Restoration）任务中因评估基准规模较小而导致的模型架构可扩展性结论不可靠的问题。其核心挑战在于：现有研究多基于小规模数据集，难以准确评估不同模型架构在更大数据量下的表现差异。为此，作者构建了一个受控的大规模基准数据集，涵盖新闻（19.9M标注词元）和小说（2.2M标注词元）两类文本，共计2210万标注词元，以更真实地反映模型在数据规模增长下的性能变化。解决方案的关键在于采用统一训练设置（固定8个训练轮次、相同学习率、无架构特异性调参），系统评估由四种预训练Transformer骨干网络与可选的双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）及条件随机场（CRF）层组合而成的17种模型架构。实验结果表明，在固定训练预算下，引入Bi-LSTM和CRF层并不能稳定提升宏平均F1得分；在八组领域-骨干对比中，有七组中纯Transformer分类器的表现不低于其对应的带循环与结构化预测头的变体。此外，尽管PhoPunct（PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF）在新闻数据上取得最佳成绩（61.35），但在小说数据上表现不及仅使用XLM-R加上CRF的模型（50.18，优于PhoPunct的48.97）。这一发现揭示了递归结构与结构化预测头的价值高度依赖于优化策略，强调应明确区分架构改进本身与特定调参带来的性能提升，从而为后续研究提供更严谨的评估范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09107
作者: Khoa D. Nguyen,Thai Bao Huynh,Binh T. Nguyen
机构: AISIA Research Lab(越南胡志明市); University of Science(越南胡志明市); Vietnam National University(越南胡志明市); University of Information Technology(越南胡志明市)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted at PACLIC 40 (2026)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Vietnamese punctuation restoration is often evaluated on relatively small benchmarks, limiting conclusions about how architectural choices scale with data volume. We present a controlled benchmark on News and Novels corpora containing 22.1 million labeled tokens (19.9M News and 2.2M Novels). We evaluate 17 architectures formed from four pretrained Transformer backbones and optional bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and conditional random field (CRF) layers, together with a PhoBERT-large-Bi-LSTM-CRF model, PhoPunct. Every model is trained for eight epochs with the same learning rate and without architecture-specific tuning. Under this fixed budget, adding Bi-LSTM and CRF layers does not reliably improve macro F1: in seven of eight matched domain-backbone comparisons, a plain Transformer classifier matches or outperforms its Bi-LSTM-CRF counterpart. PhoPunct obtains the best News result (61.35), whereas XLM-R with a CRF obtains the best Novels result (50.18), exceeding PhoPunct (48.97). These results show that the value of recurrent and structured-prediction heads depends on their optimization regime and motivate explicit separation between architectural improvements and improvements due to architecture-specific tuning. Our source code is available at: this https URL

[NLP-34] AlienBench: A Benchmark of Structural Novelty in Language Model Outputs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在创意任务中缺乏客观、可量化的创造力评估标准的问题。现有评价体系依赖人类专家或大语言模型（LLM）对输出新颖性进行主观评分，但这些评分缺乏统一的参照基准，难以衡量其相对于“熟悉范式”的实际偏离程度。为克服这一局限，论文提出以认知心理学中的“结构化想象任务”（structured imagination task）为基础，构建名为 AlienBench 的基准测试框架。该方法要求模型描述外星生物，并由三名 LLM 判官从每段描述中提取十项生物学特征，判断其是否符合地球生物典型特征（如双侧对称、四肢运动等），并统计偏离地球范式的特征数量作为创造力得分（0–10分）。关键创新在于引入了明确的“熟悉默认”参考系，使新颖性测量具备可比性和量化基础。实验结果表明，尽管部分前沿闭源模型表现较好，但开源模型在该任务中平均得分更高（5.40 vs. 4.58），且所有模型在基准提示下的平均偏离程度均超过100名人类参与者，凸显了大语言模型在突破固有思维模式方面的潜力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09094
作者: Jonas Oppenlaender,Johanna M. Silvennoinen
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 21 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for creative tasks such as writing, design, and idea generation. For these uses, it matters whether a model’s ideas depart from familiar examples or stay close to them. Novelty is one standard measure of creativity, and current creativity evaluations ask human experts or LLM judges to rate how novel an output is. However, these ratings have no fixed reference for what counts as novel (or, in other terms, departure from the familiar). Measuring this departure requires a task with known familiar defaults. The structured imagination task from cognitive psychology is such a task. In this creativity test, people imagine a creature from another planet. The departure from features of Earth animals, such as bilateral symmetry and legs as mode of locomotion, is used as measure of creativity. We introduce AlienBench, a benchmark that adapts the structured imagination task to language models. Models describe alien creatures, and a panel of three LLM judges extracts ten biological features from the description and labels them as either Earth-typical or a departure. The sum of feature departures is the score of a description, from 0 to 10. Each model describes alien creatures under six prompt conditions that vary the framing of the task and the planetary environment. Each model generates 30 descriptions per condition (180 in total), and its overall score is the mean across these descriptions. We evaluate 10 language models, from frontier to open-weight models. Overall scores range from 3.28 (GPT-6 Luna) to 6.55 (Ministral 3 14B). Interestingly, open-weight models score higher than proprietary models in this task (5.40 vs. 4.58). Under the baseline prompt, the models depart from Earth defaults more often on average than 100 human participants on every feature. We release all prompts, generations, judge outputs, and scores.

[NLP-35] MARS: Training Multilingual Search Agents for Retriever-Free Evidence Acquisition

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有多语言检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）方法对学习型检索器和基于相似度的跨语言排序高度依赖所引发的跨语言检索错误及索引开销问题。其核心挑战在于：在无需检索器的直接语料库交互（Direct Corpus Interaction, DCI）范式下，多语言搜索动作生成面临实体表面形式敏感性以及仅基于结果的监督信号难以有效指导多轮搜索的问题。为此，论文提出MARS——一种基于强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）的多语言搜索代理，其关键创新在于引入“语料库原生实体定位”（corpus-native entity grounding），通过从原始语料中恢复可靠的词汇锚点，提升检索鲁棒性；同时设计了一种冗余感知的搜索奖励机制，以鼓励生成简洁高效的搜索轨迹，缓解多语言场景下强化学习训练中的崩溃问题。实验表明，MARS在多个基准上持续优于强基线模型，展现出卓越的跨语言泛化能力，并显著减少冗余的语料库交互。

作者: Rui Qi,Yunlong Liang,Yufeng Chen,Jinan Xu,Fandong Meng,Kaiyu Huang
机构: Beijing Jiaotong University (北京交通大学); Tencent Inc. (腾讯公司)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Existing multilingual retrieval-augmented generation relies heavily on learned retrievers and similarity-based ranking from multilingual collections, which are vulnerable to cross-lingual retrieval errors and indexing overhead. In this paper, we explore retriever-free multilingual search, where the model directly interacts with raw corpora through executable shell commands. This paradigm shifts the bottleneck to multilingual search action generation, where exact search is sensitive to entity surface forms and outcome-only supervision provides limited guidance for multi-turn search. To address these challenges, we propose MARS, a multilingual search agent in direct corpus interaction (DCI) with reinforcement learning (RL). MARS introduces corpus-native entity grounding to recover reliable lexical anchors from corpus evidence, mitigating failure to retrieve evidence. Meanwhile, we present a redundancy-aware search reward to encourage concise and effective search trajectories, addressing training collapse in RL of multilingual scenarios. Experiments show that \ours~consistently outperforms strong retrieval-based and DCI baselines, while demonstrating robust cross-lingual generalization and substantially reducing redundant corpus interactions.

[NLP-36] he Invisible Gap: Romanized Indic Generation Fails Where Automatic Metrics Succeed

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前自然语言处理（NLP）评估框架中对罗马化印度语（romanized Indic）生成质量评价严重缺失的问题。尽管数亿印度用户在数字系统中使用拉丁字母拼写的印地语、泰卢固语和卡纳达语进行交流，但现有基准测试与评估体系普遍忽略此类输入输出形式，导致自动评估指标（如BGE-M3、BERTScore）无法准确反映实际生成质量。研究发现，这些指标在衡量罗马化印地语、泰卢固语及卡纳达语生成时存在系统性偏差，无法识别模型的实质性缺陷。关键解决方案在于提出一种“故障感知型评估策略”（failure-aware evaluation policy），通过主动识别并赋零分于空输出、脚本污染（script spillage）及指令崩溃（instruction collapse）等典型失败模式，从而揭示传统自动指标难以捕捉的模型缺陷。实验结果表明，有效的罗马化印迹生成评估需整合语义相似性、脚本合规性、故障覆盖率与母语者可接受性四方面要素，形成协同一致的综合性评估体系。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09085
作者: Madhu Sudhan Rao Beesetty,Surbhi Sharma,Devesh Maheshwari,Lokesh Meesala
机构: Houston Methodist(休斯顿方法学); University of Wisconsin–Madison(威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校); Morgan Stanley(摩根士丹利); PayPal(贝宝)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: 11 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. All authors contributed equally

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hundreds of millions of Indians communicate with digital systems in romanized Latin characters – typing “aap kaise hain” rather than native script – yet romanized Indic generation is absent from NLP benchmarks and evaluation frameworks. We demonstrate that automatic metrics (BGE-M3, BERTScore) systematically misrepresent the quality of romanized Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada generation. We evaluate four LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 2.5-flash, Qwen3.5-35B) on 142 OpenAssistant query-response pairs. On a 72-response diagnostic subset, native speakers rate GPT-5.5 1.43 points higher than Claude Opus 4.8 on a 12-point rubric, whereas their full-dataset BGE-M3 means differ by only 0.004. Two distinct model-specific failure modes emerge: Gemini produces script spillage (16.9% of Telugu responses leak native script), while Qwen collapses to English-only output (16.2% of Kannada responses). We introduce a failure-aware evaluation policy that assigns zero to empty outputs, script-corrupted responses, and instruction collapses – revealing failures metrics alone cannot detect. Our results show that evaluating romanized Indic generation requires a coordinated bundle: semantic similarity, script compliance, failure coverage, and native-speaker acceptability.

[NLP-37] Large Language Model Deployment on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices: A Practitioners Survey

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在资源受限的边缘设备上部署面临的挑战。尽管LLMs在众多人工智能应用中展现出卓越性能，但其庞大的计算与存储需求严重制约了其在移动和边缘设备上的实际应用。论文指出，当前的关键问题在于如何在保持模型性能的同时，有效降低对计算资源、内存和能耗的要求，从而实现高效、低延迟的边缘部署。解决方案的关键在于结合软件优化技术（如模型压缩、量化、剪枝和知识蒸馏）与专用硬件加速（如边缘AI芯片、张量处理单元），通过软硬件协同设计，在保证推理精度的前提下显著提升模型运行效率，使大语言模型能够在本地完成数据处理，实现更低延迟、更低成本以及个性化响应的边缘智能应用。

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed many areas of artificial intelligence (AI), but their substantial resource requirements limit their deployment on mobile and edge devices. Although LLMs have demonstrated impressive capabilities in various applications, the next challenge is deploying these models on resource-limited edge devices. Recent innovations in software optimizations and specialized hardware have made it feasible to deploy LLMs on edge devices. Edge deployment offers benefits including local data processing, cost savings, reduced latency, and personalized responses. This paper reviews the latest techniques that make the deployment of LLMs on edge devices feasible.

[NLP-38] Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models ?

【速读】： 该论文旨在检验一个关键假设：具备强化推理能力的大型语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）是否能在复杂、开放且具有创造性的生成任务中普遍表现出更优性能，尤其是在受读者体验细微差异影响的文本创作领域。研究聚焦于短篇小说的心理深度这一主观性极强的评价维度，通过对比推理导向微调后的模型（如DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3、GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o）与基础版本在60次盲评中的表现，采用7名人类评估者及一个集成的“大模型作为裁判”（LLM-as-a-Judge）进行评分。结果表明，人类评估未显示出一致的推理优势：尽管GPT-5在部分情境下略优于GPT-4o（偏好率60.0–62.9%），但DeepSeek-R1反而显著落后于DeepSeek-V3（偏好率仅42.9%），且评估者间一致性极低（Krippendorff’s α = 0.070），提示评价存在高度主观性而非标注失误。相比之下，“大模型作为裁判”则表现出强烈的倾向性，几乎无一例外地偏爱推理增强模型（98.3%对人类投票的55.2%），且该倾向在不同配置间稳定，并部分与句长相关。因此，该研究的核心发现是：在前沿生成任务中，推理能力带来的质量提升极为微小，极易被读者主观体验所掩盖；而依赖“大模型作为裁判”的评估体系可能掩盖这种主观性，导致对模型真实表现的误判。解决方案的关键在于认识到评估框架本身的偏差，强调需谨慎使用自动化评估工具，尤其在心理深度等高度主观的创造性生成任务中，应重视人类评估的多元性和不可替代性。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Benchmark gains from reasoning-enhanced large language models encourage the assumption that these models should broadly perform better on complex generative tasks, but this remains underexplored in open-ended, creative domains shaped by nuances of reader experience. We tested this assumption through the lens of psychological depth in short stories. We compared DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3, our closest available contrast for reasoning-oriented post-training, and GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o, through 60 blinded pairwise evaluations in which seven human annotators and an ensemble LLM-as-a-Judge rated prompt-matched story outputs. Human evaluations showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was slightly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0-62.9% across two reasoning-effort settings), whereas DeepSeek-R1 fell behind DeepSeek-V3 (42.9%). Although this pattern was marked by low inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff’s \alpha = 0.070 ), our annotation-quality checks suggested genuine evaluative subjectivity, plausibly reflecting distinct annotator decision schemes rather than annotation failure. In contrast, the LLM-as-a-Judge showed a strong pro-reasoning bias (98.3% of pairs vs. 55.2% of human votes), consistent across its five configurations and partly tracking sentence length. These findings suggest that, at the frontier, reasoning-related quality differences are small enough to be dominated by reader subjectivity, and that LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators can obscure this subjectivity in nuanced creative-generation tasks.

[NLP-39] Real-Time Short-Response Selection for Spoken Dialogue Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决语音对话系统在自然对话中响应时机不准确的问题，尤其关注语言生成与语音合成带来的延迟对用户体验的负面影响。为实现自然的交替发言（turn-taking），系统不仅需精准预测响应时机，还需掩盖生成延迟，使其不被用户感知。其核心解决方案是提出一种实时短响应选择任务（real-time short-response selection task），可与现有交替发言模型无缝集成以隐藏生成延迟。该方法通过对比学习（contrastive learning）建模对话上下文与短响应之间的映射关系，当检测到发言切换事件时，从预生成的候选响应中选择一个短响应立即播放，同时后台继续生成完整响应。实验表明，该方法能根据对话上下文有效选择合适的短响应，显著优于随机选择和基于大语言模型（LLM）的基线方法；且在保持原有交替发言预测性能的同时，仅引入极小的额外计算开销。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09057
作者: Hien Ohnaka,Kazuyo Onishi,Koichiro Yoshino
机构: Osaka University (大阪大学); National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (日本信息通信技术研究所)
类目: ound (cs.SD); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:To realize spoken dialogue systems that can interact naturally with users, it is important for the system to respond to user utterances at appropriate timings. To achieve such natural turn-taking, the system needs not only to predict appropriate response timings but also to mask delays caused by language generation and speech synthesis so that they are not perceived by the user. We propose a real-time short-response selection task that can be integrated with existing turn-taking models to mask generation delay. To address this task, the proposed model learns the mapping between dialogue context and short responses using contrastive learning. When a turn-taking event is detected, the system selects a response from a set of pre-generated candidates. The selected response is played while the main response is being generated. Experimental results show that the proposed method learns to select short responses based on dialogue context, outperforming random and LLM-based baselines. Moreover, integrating response selection maintained turn-taking prediction performance and added minimal processing overhead.

[NLP-40] Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection for Reasoning Distillation NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决小规模学生模型（student model）在迁移大规模教师模型（teacher model）生成的数学推理能力时，因训练数据分布与推理阶段实际行为不一致而导致的过拟合及泛化性能差的问题。其核心挑战在于：现有方法虽引入错误样本以弥补分布差距，但所生成的修正路径仍受限于教师模型的推理模式，学生模型难以复现，导致分布错配问题未根本解决。本文提出一种名为“失败剖析与可达成轨迹选择”（Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection, FPRT）的新方法，其关键在于构建训练数据时同时考虑学生模型的失败模式与其实际可学习能力。具体而言，通过重复采样对学生的失败行为进行剖析，基于错误率与错误一致性识别出质性上不同的失败类型；针对每种失败类型，设计差异化提示策略从教师模型中生成候选解；随后在正确候选解中筛选出在分歧点之后初始推理步骤最能被学生模型可靠复现的路径——这些初始纠正步骤构成主要瓶颈，而后续步骤则因上下文已修正而更易延续。该方法突破了传统全轨迹重排序机制对关键推理转折点信号的稀释，实现了对关键纠错路径的精准聚焦。实验表明，FPRT在五个基准测试上均显著优于现有方法，且在两种不同学生模型架构下均达到当前最优（SOTA）性能。

作者: Yijun Zhu,Jianxin Wang,Chengchao Shen
机构: Central South University (中南大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. The source code and trained weights are available at \url{ this https URL }

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Training smaller language models on reasoning solutions generated by a larger teacher model is the prevailing approach for transferring mathematical reasoning capabilities. However, the student tends to overfit the output distribution of the teacher and generalizes poorly when its own behavior at inference time deviates from the training data. Recent methods attempt to bridge this gap by incorporating error data, yet the corrective trajectories still reflect the reasoning patterns of the teacher, which the student cannot reliably reproduce, leaving the distribution mismatch largely unresolved. We propose a method, Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection (FPRT), built on the insight that effective training data should be jointly determined by what the student fails on and what it can realistically learn. Our method first profiles the failure behavior of the student on each problem through repeated sampling, characterizing it in terms of error rate and error consistency to reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes. Each mode demands a fundamentally different training signal. The diagnosed mode then guides candidate generation from the teacher via distinct prompting strategies tailored to each failure type. Among the correct candidates, our method selects the one whose initial reasoning steps after the point of divergence are most reproducible by the student. These first corrective steps constitute the primary bottleneck, while the remaining steps follow an already corrected context and can therefore be continued more readily. This contrasts with standard reranking approaches, which score the trajectory as a whole and thereby dilute the signal at the critical reasoning transition. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves the SOTA performance across the five benchmarks on both student backbones.

[NLP-41] Language Not Code Abstraction: Natural-language Training Shapes Brain-aligned Geometry NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型（Generative AI）在神经表征对齐方面是否能通过编程语言训练替代自然语言训练的问题。核心问题是：从编程语言中学习到的抽象结构是否足以产生与自然语言相当的、与人类大脑活动模式高度一致的表征。其解决方案的关键在于系统性地对比在多种代码数据（包括Python、C函数、x86-64汇编及对应机器码）和自然语言数据（TinyStories）上训练的25个GPT-2-small模型，在共享分词器与编码流程下，与随机权重模型相比的脑评分（brain score）表现。研究发现，尽管代码训练模型在多数基准上未显著优于随机权重模型，但自然语言训练模型在Pereira-243和Tuckute2024两个基准上显著超越代码模型，且其表征几何结构与神经相似性具有更强的一致性（ρ = 0.14），表明自然语言训练可生成更具生物合理性表征。此外，仅在英语语料上更新嵌入矩阵即可显著提升所有代码模型的深层对齐度，揭示了自然语言在表征构建中的关键作用。结论表明，在当前架构与训练设置下，自然语言训练仍为实现与大脑活动更紧密对齐表征的必要条件。

作者: Iñigo Parra
机构: University of California, Berkeley (加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted for the Neureps Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

Abstract:Code-trained language models produce positive brain scores, which raises the question of whether abstract structure learned from programming languages can substitute for natural-language training. We trained 25 GPT-2-small models on TinyStories, Python, C functions, x86-64 assembly, and the corresponding machine code, and scored them using a shared tokenizer and encoding procedure against matched random-weight models. On Pereira-243 and Tuckute2024, TinyStories exceeds the mean of the four code models by \Delta r = 0.053 and 0.059 (Holm-corrected p0.001 ), while code training leaves alignment near the random-weight level. The language advantage is benchmark-specific: Blank2014 shows no corrected language-code difference, and Fedorenko2016 shows no language benefit. Geometry tracks the encoding result on Pereira-243: TinyStories seeds converge on the most similar representations, and its fit-free correspondence with neural dissimilarity peaks at \rho = 0.14 , twice the code and random-weight levels. Binary-trained models have about three effective dimensions, so seed agreement alone does not imply neural correspondence. Updating only the embedding matrix on English improves mean-over-depth alignment for every code model more than an equal update on its own corpus. Within this architecture and training setup, natural-language training produces a distinct representational geometry with closer neural correspondence on Pereira-243

[NLP-42] Seeing vs. Counting: Complexity Twins Show Where Multimodal LLM s Fail on Diagrams

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大模型（Multimodal LLM）在图像中进行计数时，其错误源于视觉感知缺陷还是计算能力不足这一关键问题。现有视觉图表与谜题基准测试通常将视觉密度与算法复杂度混杂，导致难以区分二者的影响。为此，研究者设计了一种分离机制：针对同一幅图中的不同计数任务（如生成树数量——可由行列式计算，属于P类；以及简单路径数量——#P完全问题），通过文本转录探测（transcription probe）和纯文本对照实验，将“阅读”与“计算”过程解耦。实验结果表明，对于Gemini系列模型，其表现取决于内部计算方式；在链式思维（Chain of Thought）模式下，模型虽能正确识别小规模图像，但在计数阶段失败，且错误率主要受答案数值规模（每增加一个数量级，精确回答概率下降2.38倍）而非复杂度类别影响。而在提供代码及精确转录的情况下，主模型可在10×10网格上准确完成计数，此时瓶颈转为视觉阅读——单次视角会遗漏水平边，而对旋转后的裁剪副本进行二次读取可使96个大规模图形中有86个被精确识别，显著优于仅重复原始视角的57个。因此，解决方案的关键在于通过结构化任务设计与多视角输入策略，有效分离并验证模型在视觉感知与数学计算两方面的性能边界。

机构: Google(谷歌)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a multimodal LLM miscounts in a diagram, does it fail at seeing or at counting? Existing visual graph and puzzle benchmarks vary visual density and algorithmic hardness together, confounding the two. We pair counting questions about the same drawing that sit in different counting-complexity classes, such as its spanning trees (a determinant) and its simple paths (#P-complete), and use a transcription probe and a text-only control to separate reading from computing. We test Gemini, Gemma and Qwen3-VL models; for the Gemini models, the answer depends on how the model computes. In chain of thought, most of them read small drawings correctly and then fail at counting, at a rate set far more by the size of the answer than by its complexity class (for the primary model, the odds of an exact answer fall 2.38-fold per decade of the answer). Given code and an exact transcription, the primary model counts correctly even on 10x10 grids, and reading becomes the bottleneck: a single view misses horizontal edges, and a second reading of a rotated copy with crop checks reads 86/96 large grids exactly, against 57/96 when the upright reading is simply repeated.

[NLP-43] Same Facts Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在处理消费者投诉时，因投诉人语言风格差异（如年龄、教育水平及社会经济地位，SES）所引发的公平性问题。研究发现，尽管群体层面的救济结果差异微小（货币赔偿差距均在0.5个百分点以内），但在个体层面，同一投诉经不同语言风格重写后，系统决策存在显著不稳定性——2.6%至6.3%的情况下产生不同的货币赔偿决定。关键发现在于：风格差异主要影响表达方式（如词汇、语法与礼貌程度），而非内容本身；且所有模型对事实信息的响应强度远高于对语言风格的敏感度（49–387倍）。通过将所有投诉统一重写为标准语言风格，可使GPT-4o-mini模型在教育和SES维度上的差距分别缩小94%和87%，同时保持对事实的敏感性，但未能提升个体决策稳定性，且部分概率模型的偏差被反转。此外，独立审计工具在3.3%和11.7%的重写中识别出实质性事实变更，表明语言重构仍可能引入隐性偏差。因此，论文强调：对生成式AI决策系统的公平性审计应区分报告“群体差异”与“个体决策不稳定性”两类结果，以全面评估其公平性风险。

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly used to resolve consumer complaints, and the way complainants write varies with age, education and socioeconomic status (SES). We audit three remedy-decision systems using sociolinguistic rewrites of US consumer financial complaints that are instructed to preserve every fact: two generative LLMs that return a single label (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini) and a probabilistic “System One” model that returns a distribution over remedies (Jev). Using pre-registered hypotheses tested once on held-out complaints, we separate two phenomena that single-label audits conflate. At the group scale, older, college-educated and higher-SES styles receive slightly more generous remedies; these effects replicate but are small, with every monetary-remedy gap within 0.5 percentage points. At the individual scale, two style versions of the same complaint receive different monetary decisions 2.6-6.3% of the time. In a variance-component analysis of the probabilistic model, persona components shared across the two rewrite models account for about 1.6% of within-complaint variation. The persona gaps are associated mainly with delivery (vocabulary, grammar, politeness) rather than content. Positive controls show that all three systems respond 49-387 times more strongly to remedy-relevant facts than to style. Rewriting every complaint into one standard style reduced GPT-4o-mini’s education and SES gaps by 94% and 87% while retaining fact sensitivity, but reversed two of the probabilistic model’s gaps and did not make individual decisions more stable. Independent LLM auditors flagged material fact changes in 3.3% and 11.7% of rewrites, and instability persisted among unflagged rewrites. Fairness audits of LLM decision systems should report group disparities and individual instability as separate outcomes.

[NLP-44] Beyond Truncation? Entailment-Licensed Elision and the Limits of Semantic Preservation in LLM Decoding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决指令微调的大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成回答时存在冗余输出的问题，即生成内容长度远超任务实际需求。其核心挑战在于：如何在不进行额外训练的前提下，有效削减冗余内容，同时保持语义完整性与信息质量。论文提出的关键解决方案是引入一种无需训练的解码阶段控制器——蕴含许可的解码内省略（Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision, ELIDE）。ELIDE 的核心机制是在每个句子边界处，通过自然语言推理（Natural Language Inference, NLI）模型判断当前待输出文本是否可由已生成内容逻辑蕴含，若成立则跳过该部分文本，从而实现内容精简。值得注意的是，尽管该方法在多项指标上优于等长截断基准，但人工评估揭示其约59%的省略会损害答案质量，且此类错误无法被自动度量检测。后续研究表明，将蕴含判断的范围限定于话语单元（discourse unit）层级可显著降低有害省略比例，将其控制在约10%以内，从而提升实用性与可靠性。

作者: Mahmoud Alyosify,Mirna Imbabi,Eman Elkhamisi
机构: Queen’s University (皇后大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables

Abstract:Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) answer at greater length than a request needs. We ask whether a training-free controller inside the decoding loop can remove that surplus while preserving content, judged against the simplest possible baseline: truncating the model’s own answer to the same length. An entropy-gated logits processor removes 25.5-34.9% of tokens on MT-Bench development questions and 19.9-34.2% on a sealed test split within pre-registered BERTScore non-inferiority margins, yet we prove and confirm by audit that its output is always a prefix of the unmodified answer: the saving is truncation. A survey of 23 training-free mechanism families finds none that selects content better than truncation without oracle labels. We therefore introduce Entailment-Licensed In-Decoding Elision (ELIDE), which, at each sentence boundary, withholds a span from the reader only when a natural-language inference model judges it entailed by the text already shown, while leaving the model’s generation unchanged. ELIDE beats matched-length truncation on three model families, but reading 936 of its elisions on 670 public prompts shows that 59% harm the answer, a failure that no automatic measure detects. Scoping the licence to its discourse unit reduces the harmful share to about one elision in ten on two fresh tests.

[NLP-45] Using an LLM to Tackle Difficult Cases in NER for Nepali Tweets

Abstract:Named entity recognition (NER) is challenging for social media data in a low-resource language. LLMs often lag behind pretrained language models (PLMs) in NER performance, but they show promise in handling cases that PLMs struggle with. Using a dataset of Nepali tweets, we split the test set into “easy” and “hard” cases using token probabilities from a fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM). We then evaluate an LLM on the hard test cases using 16 different prompt configurations. We find that selecting examples based on semantic similarity and increasing the number of examples improves F1 score by almost 10 points from the baseline configuration. Although the LLM underperforms the PLM on the full and easy test sets, it surpasses the PLM on the hard test set, resulting in an improved score when the two models are combined.

[NLP-46] ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决量化感知训练（Quantization-aware training, QAT）中优化器内存开销过高的问题，尤其针对使用AdamW优化器时需维护每个权重矩阵两个稠密的FP32状态所导致的高内存占用。尽管低秩内存高效优化器（如GaLore和LDAdam）在常规训练中表现良好，但在QAT场景下性能显著下降，其根源在于QAT中的动量信息存在大量能量分布于主奇异子空间（top-r singular subspace）之外，而基于投影的方法会丢弃这部分信息。研究发现，仅保留残差部分的符号信息即可维持其有效性。基于此，作者提出ResQAdam：该方法仅维护一个BF16精度的动量，仅在主子空间的r×r坐标上应用Adam更新，并引入由残差计算出的归一化符号更新项以恢复被投影丢失的信息。实验表明，ResQAdam在两种从零开始的QAT方法及三种微调流程中，将权重量化至2比特时，相比AdamW降低了71%至74%的优化器状态内存开销，且在多数情况下性能接近AdamW，训练吞吐量下降不足2%。其核心创新在于通过符号保留机制有效利用了被传统投影方法舍弃的动量残差，从而在大幅降低内存消耗的同时保持模型训练精度。

作者: Liqun Ma,Shengkun Tang,Liangyu Wang,Lin Zhao,Wei Luo,Xinjun Niu,Spandan Tiwari,Ashish Sirasao,Kun Zhang,Zhiqiang Shen
机构: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI); King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST); Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD); Carnegie Mellon University (CMU)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.

[NLP-47] On the Incompleteness of do-calculus for Universal Identifiability

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决从任意观测分布和/或干预分布集合中识别因果效应的通用可辨识性（Universal Identifiability, uID）问题，该问题泛化了经典的可辨识性（ID）与广义可辨识性（gID）问题。传统方法仅针对纯观测数据或特定类型干预数据的可辨识性进行研究，并已建立相应的图模型判别准则及基于do-演算（do-calculus）与基础概率运算的算法，证明了do-演算在这些场景下具有完备性。然而，此前尚未对“do-演算完备性”给出严格的数学定义。本文首次提出一个严谨的形式化定义来刻画do-演算的完备性，并验证了已有结果中的完备性结论依然成立；但进一步表明，在更一般的uID问题中，do-演算的规则不再具备完备性，这可能是导致uID问题长期未被解决的根本原因。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08916
作者: Yaroslav Kivva,Aliaksandra Novik,Negar Kiyavash
机构: EPFL(洛桑联邦理工学院); Imperial College(帝国学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Probability (math.PR)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We study the problem of causal effect identification from an arbitrary set of observational and/or interventional distributions, which we call Universal Identifiability (uID). The uID problem generalizes existing classical identifiability (ID) and general identifiability (gID) problems, which considered the identification problem from either mere observational distributions or a specific type of interventional distributions. Prior research has established graphical criteria to determine when a causal effect is identifiable in ID and gID problems. Moreover, algorithms that leverage do-calculus and basic probability manipulations have been proposed to compute these effects. Consequently, it has been shown that do-calculus is both sound and complete in these problems. Despite these well-established results, a formal definition of what it means for the do-calculus to be complete does not exist. We propose a rigorous formalization for the completeness of the do-calculus and show that the completeness results in previous work remain valid. However, for more general problems, such as uID, the rules of do-calculus are no longer complete. This is perhaps the reason why the uID problem has remained open thus far.

[NLP-48] From Procedures to Permissions: Learning Precise Subagent Authorization from Agent Skills

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多智能体系统在执行复杂任务时，如何精准分配子任务所需工具与工作空间资源的问题。现有代理系统虽能控制工具调用和执行环境，但缺乏对每个子任务所需资源的显式指定机制，且仅依赖任务结果和执行轨迹难以有效监督权限分配的合理性。其解决方案的关键在于利用嵌入在代理技能（Agent Skills）中的过程性知识——即每一步操作所涉及的工具、文件及具体操作——作为授权决策的监督信号。研究通过从技能中合成任务与逐步执行流程，在交互环境中进行子代理委派，并基于验证后的执行轨迹构建训练数据，从而实现对任务执行与权限分配的联合优化。实验表明，该方法在ClawArena-Team基准上使工具权限精度提升13.4个百分点、工作空间权限精度提升24.1个百分点，同时整体任务成功率提高11.6个百分点（以Qwen3.5-35B-A3B为例），证明了过程性知识可为子代理协同提供任务结果无法替代的精细监督能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08905
作者: Wenkai Yu,Ning Ding,Wentao Zhang,Yehui Tang
机构: Samsung Research, Beijing, China(三星研究院，北京，中国); Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As language agents tackle increasingly complex tasks, they increasingly rely on multiple agents to coordinate specialized work, requiring decisions not only about what each subagent should do but also which tools and workspace resources it should access. Existing agent systems provide mechanisms for controlling tools and execution environments, but do not directly specify the resources required by each delegated subtask. Moreover, task outcomes and execution trajectories alone provide limited supervision for determining whether a subagent has received appropriate permissions. We observe that Agent Skills encode procedural knowledge describing the operations, tools, and files required at each step, providing a natural source of supervision for authorization. Building on this observation, we synthesize tasks and step-by-step procedures from Skills, execute them through subagent delegation in interactive environments, and use verified trajectories to construct training data for task execution and authorization. On ClawArena-Team, our method improves tool permission precision by 13.4 percentage points and workspace permission precision by 24.1 percentage points, while increasing overall task success by 11.6 percentage points for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. On Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SkillsBench, our method remains competitive with existing agent data synthesis approaches. These results show that the procedural knowledge embedded in Agent Skills provides a source of supervision for precise subagent orchestration that task outcomes alone cannot provide.

[NLP-49] Richness Is Not Evenness: Ordered Renyi Crossings under Self-Training

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在递归自训练（recursive self-training）过程中出现的“模型坍缩”（model collapse）问题，即模型在持续自我生成文本进行微调时，词汇表逐渐缩小，高频词（主要为功能词）的主导地位被削弱，导致语言多样性下降。其核心解决方案的关键在于通过系统性地分析不同训练采样温度（training-data sampling temperature）下多种信息熵度量（如最小熵、碰撞熵、香农熵和观测丰富度）的变化趋势，揭示熵增与熵减之间的动态转折点。研究发现，随着训练温度升高，各类熵值的变化顺序呈现出可重复的交叉现象：最小熵最先由损失转为增益，随后是碰撞熵、香农熵和观测丰富度；在此区间内，词类数量减少但最常见词的支配性减弱，表明模型在压缩词汇的同时实现了更均衡的分布。特别地，在无截断训练且温度T=1时，第9代模型词汇量降至初始的13,000词，词类数减少24%，但碰撞熵反而提升0.91比特，说明模型在降低复杂度的同时仍保持一定多样性。该现象在不同采样网格、测量采样器、固定词预算及多组随机种子下均稳定存在，并在印地语和多种文本表示形式中验证了熵交叉顺序的一致性。进一步通过解码与采样机制的分离实验（如下一词身份识别和类别模拟），确认该现象并非由采样偏差引起，而是模型内在演化特性所致。此外，使用人类文本微调同样可引发类似熵分裂现象，且不伴随似然下降，表明单一熵序无法可靠指示模型质量劣化。因此，作者建议在报告模型性能时应同时提供指定词预算下的熵谱（entropy profile）与独立的质量评估指标，以全面刻画模型在自训练过程中的演化状态。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08892
作者: Pranjal Srivastava
机构: University of Michigan(密歇根大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recursive self-training of language models, a setting studied in model collapse, can reduce vocabulary while making frequent words, mostly function words, less dominant. We fine-tune English GPT-2 on its own output for nine generations, vary the training-data sampling temperature, and measure every model with one fixed sampler. As training temperature rises, Renyi entropy changes turn from loss to gain at distinct temperatures: min-entropy first, then collision entropy, Shannon entropy and observed richness. Between the outer crossings, word types fall while the most-common word becomes less dominant. Untruncated training at T = 1 lies in this interval: at 13,000 words, generation 9 has 24% fewer types than generation 0 yet collision entropy is 0.91 bits higher. The ordering persists with a finer grid, different measurement samplers, a fixed word budget and five fresh training seeds. Min-entropy again crosses before richness in four further settings (in Hindi only at interpolated roots) and in 12 of 13 distinct measurements under eight text representations. Next-token identities and a categorical simulation isolate decoding and sampling effects; the crossing order remains empirical. Fine-tuning on human text can produce the same split while likelihood improves, and no single order’s sign reliably identifies worse likelihood across the tested settings. We recommend reporting entropy profiles at stated budgets with an independent quality measure.

[NLP-50] Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models : A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLM s ML4H2026 ALT

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生物医学领域微调大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）过程中出现的知识性回避行为退化问题。尽管微调可显著降低模型训练成本并提升特定领域的性能，但已有研究表明其可能导致安全防护机制弱化，尤其在知识性回避（knowledge-centric abstention）方面表现不佳——即模型在面对不确定或超出知识范围的问题时，未能恰当选择不回答。现有研究多聚焦于价值导向的拒绝响应，而本文则关注知识导向的回避行为。为评估微调对知识性回避的影响，作者对25个生物医学领域微调模型及其对应的11对基础模型进行了系统审计，使用MedAbstain和ClinDet-Bench两个基准进行测评。结果显示，基础模型在MedAbstain上的适当回避率中位数仅为8.3%，微调后进一步下降至4.2%（在25对模型中有21对呈现下降），且变化趋势在不同模型对间表现出高度异质性。这一发现揭示了当前微调方法在提升领域能力的同时，可能损害模型应有的谨慎性。因此，论文提出的关键解决方案在于发展能够同时增强领域适应性与保持适当知识性回避的微调方法，以确保模型在实际应用中的可靠性与安全性。

作者: Stephen Peng,Vineet Jagadeesan Nair,Noah Broestl,Anne Friederike Kleppe,Steven Mills,Adi Zolotov
机构: BCG X AI Science Institute, Boston Consulting Group(波士顿咨询集团); Centre for Human-Inspired Artificial Intelligence, University of Cambridge(剑桥大学人类启发式人工智能中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: To be published in the Proceedings of the 6th Machine Learning for Health Symposium (ML4H 2026), PMLR volume 346

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding. Fine-tuning promises high-performing models at a fraction of the cost of training a base model, but it can also produce unintended behavioral changes. Multiple studies have shown that safety guardrails can erode with fine-tuning, yet large-scale studies across model architectures, data mixtures, and fine-tuning methodologies remain limited. Where prior work in this space has studied value-centric refusal, this work focuses on knowledge-centric abstention. We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench to evaluate the impact of fine-tuning on knowledge-centric abstention. We find that defined appropriate abstention measured by these benchmarks, already low in base models (median 8.3% on MedAbstain), falls further after fine-tuning (median 4.2%, decreasing in 21 of 25 pairs on MedAbstain), and that the magnitude and direction of change are heterogeneous across pairs. These results motivate fine-tuning methods that improve domain-specific capability while preserving appropriate caution.

[NLP-51] Jacobian-Causal Memory Control for Persistent Memory in Language Model Systems

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决持久性内存系统（persistent-memory systems）在信息检索与推理过程中，如何精确控制记忆干预（memory intervention）对当前推断影响的问题，尤其关注如何在保证目标效果的同时，有效约束副作用并实现可回滚的动态调控。其核心挑战在于，传统方法难以在不引入不可控干扰的情况下，量化并管理多条记忆信息对模型输出的非线性、非加性交互作用。解决方案的关键在于提出雅可比因果记忆控制（Jacobian-causal memory control, JCMC），通过在共享行为测量空间中以预测的影响签名（influence signature）形式表征每项授权的记忆干预，基于目标效应与副作用预算进行选择，并在执行后通过对比预测与实际观测效应来决定是否保留或回滚干预。该方法在显式平滑性与有界估计假设下，建立了二次局部近似误差上界，刻画了由一组签名可达的目标效应范围，给出了签名误差下的选择后悔（regret）上界，并对同时激活的记忆间非加性交互进行了量化约束。该研究虽未提供基准测试数据，但定义了一种成对反事实估计器和评估协议，用于与相关性、图结构及策略过滤等基线方法进行比较。若这些简化基线在相同模型、记忆、策略及成本预算下能够达到同等水平的目标效应定位、副作用控制与回滚效用，则本文的核心主张将被削弱或证伪。

作者: Marvin Danig(Achiral Research)
机构: Achiral Research(非手性研究)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Architecture and formal analysis preprint. Four conditional theorems; no benchmark measurements. Companion research essay: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Persistent-memory systems choose not only which records are retrieved but which prior information can alter current inference. We propose Jacobian-causal memory control (JCMC), which represents each authorized memory intervention by a predicted influence signature in a shared behavioral measurement space, selects interventions against a target effect and side-effect budget, and compares predicted with observed effects before retaining or rolling back the intervention. Under explicit smoothness and bounded-estimation assumptions, we prove a quadratic local-approximation bound, characterize the target effects reachable by a set of signatures, bound selection regret under signature error, and bound non-additive interactions between simultaneous memories. The paper reports no benchmark measurements; it defines a paired counterfactual estimator and an evaluation protocol comparing JCMC with relevance, graph, and policy-filtered retrieval baselines. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if those simpler baselines match effect targeting, side-effect control, and rollback utility under equal model, memory, policy, and cost budgets.

[NLP-52] Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS): A Formal Mathematical Framework

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多文档语境下传统语义文本相似度（STS）方法无法区分各来源对目标文档的边际语义贡献的问题，尤其在多个源文档共同影响一个或多个目标文档时，成对STS因共享词汇而难以剥离个体贡献。其核心解决方案是提出语义条件相似度（Semantic Conditional Similarity, SCS），通过集合论操作从参考文档中移除与条件文档共享的语义成分，从而实现对特定源文档贡献的精准量化。SCS的关键创新在于：引入方向性，将关系划分为横向（源间）与纵向（源到目标）；通过条件化三元组（目标-参考-条件文档）构建角色依赖的非对称比较框架；实现跨文档条件化，弥补现有C-STS方法仅限于文档内条件化的局限；并采用无阈值的集合分解方式，自动分离共享与残余内容，避免人为设定相似度阈值带来的偏差。该框架可扩展至1→n及m→n情形，覆盖完整的文档数量谱系，其得分应作为序数排名理解，反映边际贡献程度而非绝对度量。这一方法揭示了传统相似性度量中常被假设的度量空间公理在角色差异化多文档场景中的表达力限制，表明引入条件三元组可恢复成对对称比较所抑制的信息。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08778
作者: Mehmet Murat Albayrakoğlu
机构: Işık University (伊什克大学); Istanbul, Turkey
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 34 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, to be submitted for publication

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) operates on document pairs, returning a single scalar per comparison. In a multi-document setting where several sources may have contributed to one or more targets, pairwise STS cannot disentangle each source’s marginal semantic contribution from their shared vocabulary. In this paper, Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS) is introduced as a conditional form of STS that computes similarity between two documents after eliminating semantic elements shared with a third via set-theoretic operations. SCS makes four contributions: 1) it introduces directionality, partitioning pairwise relations into lateral (inter-source) and vertical (source-to-target) classes; 2) conditioning induces role-dependent asymmetry by extending the comparison domain from unordered pairs to ordered, conditioned triples of a target, a reference, and a conditioning document; 3) SCS introduces inter-document conditioning by subtracting shared content from a third document, complementing the intra-document conditioning in recent C-STS work; and 4) the set-theoretic decomposition achieves threshold-free partitioning of shared and residual content, requiring no arbitrary similarity cutoff. Although developed for the n \to 1 configuration, the framework extends to 1 \to n via vertical role reversal and to m \to n via independent composition of source- and target-side conditioning. With the established 1 \to 1 case, these span the full spectrum of document cardinality. SCS scores should be interpreted ordinally, as rankings of marginal contributions rather than absolute measurements. The broader implication is that metric space axioms commonly assumed in similarity formalizations constrain expressiveness in role-differentiated multi-document settings, and that extending the domain to conditioned triples can recover information that pairwise-symmetric comparisons suppress.

[NLP-53] AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLM s via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在面对越狱攻击（jailbreak attacks）时，其安全机制易被绕过而生成有害或非预期输出的问题。现有防御方法通常通过微调模型或对特定组件进行针对性干预来提升安全性，但此类方法存在计算成本高、可能导致灾难性遗忘等缺陷。更关键的是，现有方案往往将“干预位置选择”与“干预强度设计”分步优化，忽略了二者之间的内在耦合关系——最优干预位置依赖于具体的干预方式，反之亦然，导致整体防御效果受限。为此，本文提出AttentionSwitch，作为首个在冻结的LLM中联合优化干预位置与干预强度的越狱防御框架。其核心创新在于：学习一组稀疏的注意力头，并结合查询相关的乘法缩放因子，实现对选定注意力头输出的增强或抑制，且不改变其表征方向。该方法在多种主流语言模型和越狱攻击场景下均显著优于现有防御策略，尤其在训练数据稀缺的情况下表现突出。

作者: Doniyorkhon Obidov,Honggang Yu,Xiaolong Guo,Kaichen Yang
机构: Michigan Technological University(密歇根理工大学); Miami University(迈阿密大学); Lehigh University(利哈伊大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. Although safety can be improved through model fine-tuning, such approaches can be computationally expensive and may degrade previously acquired capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Recent jailbreak defenses have therefore explored targeted interventions on specific model components associated with unsafe behavior. However, existing approaches typically decouple two inherently related decisions: where to intervene and how to modify the selected components. Such sequential optimization may be suboptimal because the optimal intervention location can depend on the intervention applied there, and vice versa. In this work, we introduce AttentionSwitch, the first jailbreak defense to jointly optimize intervention sites and strengths within a frozen LLM. Specifically, AttentionSwitch learns a sparse set of attention heads together with query-conditioned multiplicative scaling factors, allowing the outputs of the selected heads to be either attenuated or amplified without altering the directions of their representations. Across popular language models and jailbreak attacks, AttentionSwitch outperforms existing defenses, with particularly strong results when training data is scarce.

[NLP-54] Structuring Survey Histories for LLM Digital Twins: A Controlled Study of Background Decision Procedure and Evaluation Profiles NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的数字孪生系统在预测个体在新情境中行为反应时，如何有效构建用户历史响应的结构化表示以提升预测准确性的问题。现有研究表明，压缩问卷历史数据并不必然降低预测性能，提示表示结构本身可能比信息量更为关键。为此，研究提出并评估了一种固定结构的表示方法——背景-决策过程-评估（BDE），将每位受访者的问卷历史划分为三个核心维度：背景（Background）、决策过程（Decision procedure）和评估（Evaluation）。在Twin-2K-500数据集上的实验表明，相较于原始问卷文本，通过完全推断生成的BDE表示在gpt-5.4-nano和gpt-5.4-mini模型上分别提升了1.27个百分点（p < 0.01）和1.19个百分点（p < 0.001）的整体预测准确率。进一步分析显示，尽管增加推理深度未带来显著性能提升，但引入“评估”模块可使整体准确率分别提高1.44个百分点（p < 0.001）和1.22个百分点（p < 0.001），且其在价格预测任务中亦优于等长自由格式描述。因此，该研究的关键发现在于：BDE表示的优势并非源于数据压缩或长度差异，而是主要归因于其合理的组件构成，即三元结构中的“评估”部分对预测性能具有决定性贡献。

作者: Iris Ye,Tianze Deng,Ozan Candogan
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 10 pages. Camera-ready version for SocialAgent: Second Workshop on Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation, NeurIPS 2026

Abstract:LLM-based digital twins aim to predict how individuals would respond in new settings from representations of their prior responses. Existing evidence that compression of survey histories need not reduce predictive accuracy suggests that representation structure, rather than information volume alone, may be an important design choice. We study BDE, a fixed representation that organizes each respondent’s survey history into Background, Decision procedure, and Evaluation. We evaluate it on Twin-2K-500 (Toubia et al., 2025) by predicting each respondent’s held-out answers on 17 tasks. In a paired evaluation with 100 respondents, a fully inferred BDE profile improves overall accuracy over the raw survey transcript by 1.27 percentage points (pp) on gpt-5.4-nano (p 0.01) and 1.19 pp on gpt-5.4-mini (p 0.001). Three analyses then examine the schema, extraction depth, and component composition. Against a length-matched free-form profile written from the same transcript by the same extractor, BDE improves pricing accuracy on both simulators (2.15 pp on nano, p 0.01; 1.38 pp on mini, p 0.05), while its overall advantage is significant only on nano (1.05 pp, p 0.05). Allowing deeper inference during extraction yields no statistically significant gain on either simulator. By contrast, adding Evaluation to a Background–Decision procedure profile improves overall accuracy by 1.44 pp on nano (p 0.001) and 1.22 pp on mini (p 0.001). These results indicate that the advantage over raw transcripts is not explained by compression or length alone, and attribute it primarily to profile composition rather than deeper extraction.

[NLP-55] Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决工业场景中基于表格数据的欺诈分类任务中，主流的梯度提升树（Gradient-Boosted Trees）模型在部署后存在“盲区”（blind spots）且重新训练模型存在风险的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在不修改现有生产模型的前提下，安全有效地提升模型对未覆盖欺诈模式的识别能力。解决方案的关键在于提出一种无需改动原模型的可逆式补丁框架：利用大语言模型（LLM）根据SHAP值识别出被原模型低估的特征，生成以这些特征为锚点的规则；随后通过经验支持筛选并校准生成的噪声规则池，形成一个可加、可逆的对数提升（log-lift）叠加层，该叠加层在生产环境的决策阈值处运行。为降低单个LLM预测的高方差问题，采用三个多样化模型通过等权重逻辑值平均进行集成，以牺牲峰值性能为代价换取更稳定的最坏情况表现。实验表明，在真实电商反欺诈系统上，该方法在选择性偏差数据下持续训练性能退化时仍能实现平均+2.26%召回率（ΔR@P）和+1.60%精确率（ΔP@R）的增益；在公开基准的七种设计偏差变体上，所有变体均获得ΔP@R提升，同时ΔR@P保持接近中性。每个修正规则均为可读的谓词表达，明确描述其所覆盖的欺诈模式。

Abstract:In industrial tabular fraud classification, gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art, but even a well-trained model has blind spots, and retraining the deployed model is not always safe. We propose a framework that patches such a model without modifying it: LLMs propose rules anchored on features the model underweights by SHAP, and the resulting noisy pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay that runs at the production cut-off. Single-LLM benefit is high-variance and inverts between datasets, so we pool three diverse backbones by equal-weight logit averaging, trading peak gain for a bounded worst case. On a real-world e-commerce fraud detector trained on selection-biased data, continued training regresses even when carefully tuned, whereas the overlay gains on average +2.26% recall at equal precision ( \Delta R@P) and +1.60% precision at equal recall ( \Delta P@R) over production cut-offs spanning 30-57% precision and 23-63% recall. On a public benchmark of seven designed bias-shift variants it raises \Delta P@R on every variant and keeps \Delta R@P near neutral. Each amendment is a readable predicate naming the fraud pattern it covers.

[NLP-56] RL-ATTACK: A Generalized Black-Box Adversarial Attack on Language Models via Reinforcement Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在对抗性扰动下的安全性问题，即模型容易受到精心设计的输入扰动影响而产生非预期输出。现有黑盒攻击方法在无法获取梯度信息的情况下，依赖外部先验知识盲目猜测对抗变换，忽略了目标模型反馈的关键信息。为此，本文提出一种基于强化学习的可训练黑盒攻击框架，通过与目标模型交互并利用其反馈信号来自主学习生成针对性强的对抗性变换。该方案的核心在于将攻击过程建模为一个序列决策问题，使攻击者能够动态优化扰动策略，在保证语义合理性的同时显著降低模型的准确率。实验结果表明，该方法在自然语言推理和生成式问答任务中均表现出更优的攻击效果：在自然语言推理任务中，仅用20次查询即可将攻击后准确率降至2%；在生成式语言模型攻击中，训练后的攻击者性能优于未训练攻击者，并在6个测试场景中的4个超越强基线优化方法。此外，研究还发现不同奖励设计与训练设置的效果并无绝对优劣，需根据具体任务权衡。

作者: Taikun Chen,Yue Zhang,Wei Qian,Hui Fang
机构: University of Delaware(特拉华大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) exhibit vulnerabilities to adversarial perturbations that can induce unintended responses. These vulnerabilities can be identified via intentional attacks and subsequently used to improve model safety. In black-box settings where gradients are inaccessible, existing methods tend to guess adversarial transformations using external knowledge, ignoring the information provided by the target model. To mitigate this, we propose a trainable black-box framework based on reinforcement learning, which learns from the target model to generate tailored adversarial transformations. We demonstrate that our approach achieves lower post-attack accuracy, greater query efficiency and better semantic preservation on both natural language inference and generative QA tasks. On natural language inference, it drives post-attack accuracy to 2% within 20 queries. Against generative language models, our trained attacker consistently achieves lower post-attack accuracy than the untrained attacker and wins in 4 out of 6 settings when compared to a strong optimization-based baseline. We further experiment with multiple reward designs and training settings, and we find that no design or setting is consistently dominant. Our code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-57] Dual-Stream LLM -Guided Reward Design for Reject-Inference-Aware Reinforcement Learning in E-Commerce Payment Fraud Detection ACL ACL2025

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生产环境中欺诈检测模型因数据截断（censored data）导致的偏差问题：由于历史系统拦截的交易未被标注，模型仅基于已通过的交易进行训练，从而学习到有偏的“批准仅”（approved-only）分布。其核心解决方案是将生成式 AI (Generative AI) 引导的奖励设计框架扩展至奖励函数内部，提出一种双流奖励机制（dual-stream reward）。该机制的关键在于：第一流采用标准的金额加权精确率目标对已标注交易进行评估；第二流则通过对比最新梯度提升风险信号与原始拦截决策所依据的历史评分，对被旧系统拦截但无标签的交易进行打分。该方法不预设哪些特征重要，而是向大语言模型（LLM）提供一个包含多源证据的超集，由其根据评估反馈自主选择并决定使用哪些信号，且因其以代码形式生成奖励函数，决策过程具备可审计性。在四个月的跨时测试中，该双流代理在80%、85%和90%召回率下分别比仅使用标注数据的基线模型提升4.7、2.4和3.0个百分点的金额加权精确率，并平均优于生产基准6.8个百分点，同时保持与原架构一致，无额外推理开销。
